title: Postdoc in clinical Raman spectroscopy and AI-based diagnostics
description:
A position as Postdoc (full-time) is vacant at the TE Andersen Lab part of the Research Unit of Clinical Microbiology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Shape the future of clinical diagnostics

We are seeking an ambitious and highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to help establish next-generation Raman spectroscopy technologies for clinical microbiology. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the interface between optics, artificial intelligence, microbiology and clinical diagnostics in close collaboration with hospitals, industry and international research partners.

Research environment

The successful candidate will join the research group led by Professor Thomas Emil Andersen. The group conducts translational research in microbiology, advanced infection models, spectroscopy and medical technology. We collaborate extensively with Danish and international hospitals, universities and industrial partners, with a strong focus on translating innovative technologies into improved patient care.

The academic position

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, and supervision.

Your responsibilities will consist of the following:

  • Lead OUH contributions to the EU- and state-funded projects (Innovation Fund Denmark project nanoRaman, two Eurostars projects MbCare and QMIC, and the MedTech Odense project UriNix).

  • Design, plan and execute experimental studies from concept to publication.

  • Develop Raman spectroscopy workflows for analysis of clinical samples.

  • Apply machine learning and AI for spectral analysis and diagnostic classification.

  • Coordinate collaborations across hospitals, academia and industrial partners.

  • Build and develop a Raman spectroscopy research platform within the Andersen Lab.

  • Supervise students and junior researchers.

  • Publishing results in leading international journals and contributing to future grant applications.

Expectations and qualifications

We are looking for candidates holding a PhD in physics, engineering, optics, spectroscopy, biomedical engineering or a related discipline. The candidate may also hold a PhD within health sciences, biology, microbiology or similar but should then also hold significant knowledge and experience within optical sciences, spectroscopy and related data handling.

Essential qualifications:

  • Significant knowledge and experience with Raman spectroscopy.

  • Experience with optical instrumentation.

  • Experience with machine learning and/or AI.

  • Experience analysing biological or clinical samples.

  • Profound in scientific writing and a solid publication record.

Desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with clinical microbiology or hospital diagnostics.

  • Experience in academia–industry collaborations.

  • Project coordination skills.

  • Ability to work independently while thriving in multidisciplinary teams.

What we offer

  • A unique translational research environment combining engineering and medicine.

  • Participation in major externally funded collaborative projects.

  • Close interaction with clinicians, engineers and industrial partners.

  • Access to state-of-the-art spectroscopy and microbiology facilities.

  • Excellent opportunities for scientific publishing, networking and career development.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision - We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future - it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research - with people at the centre; strong research environments - as drivers of development; and the research journey - from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Professor Thomas Emil Andersen, e-mail: thandersen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 21261634 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477.

Application deadline

August 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at the laboratory of Professor Andersen at the Department of Clinical Microbiology, Odense University Hospital, J. B. Winsløws Vej 21.1, Odense C, Denmark. The laboratory and department will move to the newly built University Hospital associated with the University of Southern Denmark, in late summer 2027.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden

title: Kok til The Food Company - fri hver aften og weekender
description:
Forestil dig et kokkejob, hvor du har fri hver aften og alle weekender

Faste dagsvagter • Fri hver aften • Fri alle weekender • 37 timer

Du elsker at lave god mad.

Men måske er du blevet træt af sene aftener, weekendarbejde og at skulle vælge mellem dit arbejde og dit privatliv.

Hos The Food Company behøver du ikke vælge. Vi søger en fagligt dygtig kok, der stadig brænder for håndværket – men som også sætter pris på at kunne spise aftensmad med familien, have fri i weekenderne og vide, hvornår arbejdsdagen slutter.

Her får du et køkken med høj faglighed, gode kolleger og ordnede forhold - uden de klassiske arbejdstider, som mange kokke gerne vil væk fra.

Det får du hos os

✔ Fast arbejde på daghold

✔ Fri hver aften

✔ Fri alle weekender

✔ 37 timers fuldtidsstilling

✔ Eget parti med ansvar og indflydelse

✔ Et stærkt køkkenteam, der hjælper hinanden

✔ Mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt

Kort sagt: Du får mulighed for at arbejde med det, du elsker, samtidig med at du får mere tid til livet uden for køkkenet.

 

Et køkken, hvor kvalitet og fællesskab går hånd i hånd

Hos The Food Company laver vi mad med stolthed.

Vi tror på godt håndværk, gode råvarer og kolleger, der spiller hinanden gode.

Du får ansvar for dit eget parti og følger produktionen hele vejen fra planlægning til den færdige ret. Vi giver dig frihed til at tage ansvar, fordi vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes af dygtige mennesker, der får lov til at bruge deres faglighed.

Samtidig står du aldrig alene. Vi arbejder som ét hold og hjælper hinanden, når der er travlt. Det skaber både høj kvalitet og en arbejdsplads, hvor man har lyst til at møde ind.

 

Vi tror på, at de bedste kokke...

...har faglig stolthed.

...kan lide at tage ansvar.

...nyder at samarbejde.

...har øje for kvalitet.

...og altid ønsker at levere et godt resultat.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

 

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet kok, eller har solid erfaring fra et professionelt køkken.

Du arbejder struktureret, bevarer overblikket og sætter en ære i, at det, der forlader dit parti, altid lever op til en høj standard.

Du kommer med en positiv indstilling og bidrager til et godt samarbejde, fordi du ved, at den bedste mad bliver skabt af et godt team.

 

Vi hjælper hinanden

Hos os er ingen opgaver vigtigere end fællesskabet.

Når der er travlt, giver vi en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det. Vi tror ikke på "det er ikke mit bord" – vi tror på holdånd.

Det er en vigtig del af vores kultur, og det er også derfor, vi kalder vores måde at arbejde på Service by Feeling.

 

Praktisk

Arbejdstid

37 timer om ugen, mandag til fredag i dagtimerne.

Mødetid typisk omkring kl. 06.00

Arbejdssted

Ny Banegårdsgade 48

8000 Aarhus C

Tiltrædelse

Hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

 

Kunne det være dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV via vores rekrutteringssystem.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, så snart vi har fundet den rette kollega.

Måske er du allerede godt tilfreds med dit nuværende job.

Men hvis du savner mere balance i hverdagen, uden at gå på kompromis med dit fag – så synes vi, du skal tage en snak med os.

title: Mere tid til klienterne, mindre til papirarbejde – klinisk psykolog søges til Healper
description:
Om Healper

Healper er Danmarks største netværk af terapeuter og samlingspunktet for mental sundhed. Over 80.000 mennesker har allerede brugt Healper til at finde den rigtige psykolog, og hver dag matcher vi hundredvis af klienter med erfarne psykologer og terapeuter i hele landet – ud fra et netværk på over 350 psykologer. På grund af stor efterspørgsel udvider vi nu på tværs af Danmark.

Flere af os har selv siddet på klientsiden og mærket, hvor svært det kan være at finde den rette og rettidige hjælp – det er den oplevelse, der driver os til at gøre hjælpen mere personlig, mere menneskelig og langt mere tilgængelig.

Om stillingen

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver psykoterapeutiske samtaleforløb med individuelle klienter – særligt unge med angst eller depression. Du får klienterne leveret gennem Healpers matching, så du kan bruge din tid på det, du er bedst til, klienterne. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores Care Team.

Udover dette vil din dagligdag bestå af:

  • Klinisk sparring med Care Team omkring komplekse eller akutte klientsager

  • Være med til at videreudvikle det faglige grundlag for vores matching – kriterierne for, hvad der skaber et godt match mellem klient og psykolog

  • Bidrage til fagligt indhold (fx artikler, guides og spørgeskemaer) om mental sundhed til klienter og psykologer

  • Sikre at platform og kommunikation lever op til fagetiske retningslinjer og gældende lovgivning

  • Løbende dialog med psykologer i netværket om faglige emner, feedback og udvikling

Stillingen passer særligt godt til dig, som

  • Ønsker at arbejde primært med samtaleterapi i klinisk praksis

  • Værdsætter gode faglige rammer, ro omkring arbejdet og tid til den enkelte klient

  • Ønsker løbende faglig udvikling gennem supervision og efteruddannelse

  • Trives med selvstændigt behandlingsansvar

Hos os kan du koncentrere dig om det vigtigste – det terapeutiske arbejde. Vi har et velfungerende administrativt og digitalt setup, som giver dig mulighed for at bruge din energi på klienterne frem for på administration.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Fastansættelse i funktionærstilling med fast løn

  • Metodefrihed og høj grad af faglig autonomi

  • Fast intern og ekstern supervision

  • Et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab præget af høj faglighed og psykologisk tryghed

  • Sunde rammer for caseload, klientflow og arbejdsliv

  • Adgang til sparring i Healpers netværk af psykologer

Om dig

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Er uddannet klinisk psykolog

  • Har solid interesse for psykoterapeutisk behandlingsarbejde

  • Meget gerne har erfaring med unge

Har du flere års erfaring, får du naturligvis mulighed for at bringe dine kompetencer i spil.

Det praktiske

  • 30-37 timer ugentligt (fuldtid eller deltid)

  • Forskellige lokationer i hele Region Midtjylland

  • Opstart: snarest muligt eller efter nærmere aftale

  • Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet de rette kandidater – send derfor din ansøgning hurtigst muligt

Send din ansøgning og CV til ch@healper.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Christina Haurum på 30703670.

title: STARK Svendborg søger Lagermedarbejder
description:
Jobbeskrivelse

Vil du være med til at sikre at vores kunder altid får den bedste service, når de henvender sig på lageret? Vil du være en del af et stærkt fællesskab med gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar? Hos STARK Svendborg søger vi en engageret Lagermedarbejder, der vil være med til at forme både sin egen og STARKs fremtid som Danmarks førende distributør af byggematerialer.


Din rolle som Lagermedarbejder i STARK
Du bliver en del af lageret i STARK Svendborg, hvor vi målrettet arbejder med lagerstyring og for at give vores kunder den bedste service. Som STARKs nye Lagermedarbejder vil du få en vigtig rolle i at servicere kunderne og håndtere både ind- og udgående varer i samarbejde med resten af teamet. Det betyder at du:

  • Er ansvarlig for varemodtagelse og -registrering.

  • Sikrer et altid salgsklart lager, hvilket inkluderer vareopfyldning, trimning, prisskiltning på hyldeforkanter samt oprydning og orden.  

  • Arbejder med ordrehåndtering, herunder pluk og pak, emballering og læsning på lastvogn.

  • Tager del i at sikre at lageret altid er et sikkert sted at færdes – både for medarbejdere og kunder.

  • Indgår i et tæt samarbejde med kollegaer på lageret, for at sikre optimal koordinering og effektiv planlægning af varehåndtering og ordrebehandling.  

  • Med fordel har truckcertifikat og kørekort B.


Vores nye Lagermedarbejder
Du vil blive en del af at sikre, at vi efterlever vores værdier. Det betyder, at vi udviser ordentlighed, passion og stolthed overfor vores kunder, samarbejdspartnere, leverandører og kollegaer i det daglige arbejde. For at trives i rollen som lagermedarbejder er det vigtigt, at du:

  • Er effektiv i planlægning og evner at navigere efter fakta og se de små detaljer.

  • Er stabil og tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og lægger vægt på det gode samarbejde.

Den rette kandidat, for os, kan både være faglært og ufaglært inden for lagerlogistik eller med anden relevant uddannelse. Selvom produktkendskab og brancheerfaring kan være nyttigt, er det ikke en forudsætning. Det vigtigste for os er din interesse og motivation for at arbejde med lagerhåndtering, kundeservice og at blive en del af STARK holdet.
 


Yderligere jobbeskrivelse

Bliv en del af STARK holdet

Hos STARK ser vi mangfoldighed som en værdifuld egenskab, og vores medarbejderes bidrag er nøglen til vores fremgang. Vi opfordrer derfor alle, som kan se sig selv i stillingen til at søge. Udover gode arbejdsforhold og ansættelse på overenskomst har vi personalepolitikker, der tilgodeser medarbejderen i tråd med STARKs værdi om ordentlighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer og vi håber, at du kan starte senest d. 1. september 2026

Send os dit CV med en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge stillingen hos STARK Svendborg via linket. Vi inviterer til samtaler løbende og afslutter, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål jobbet, eller er du nysgerrig på at vide mere om STARK Svendborg som din kommende arbejdsplads, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef Erik Johansen på telefon +45 41915420

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

___________________________________________________

Om STARK

STARK er Danmarks største forhandler og distributør af byggematerialer med flere end 80 forretninger i Danmark og Grønland. STARK tilbyder også faglig rådgivning og en lang række services til både entreprenører og professionelle håndværkere. Virksomheden beskæftiger over 2.400 medarbejdere og er en del af STARK Group, der med flere end 18.500 medarbejdere og 1.050 forretninger og distributionscentre i Norden, Storbritannien, Tyskland og Østrig, er en førende leverandør af byggematerialer i Europa.

STARK Group har SBTi-godkendte net zero klimamål for 2050. Koncernen har underskrevet FN’s Global Compact principper og er anerkendt af EcoVadis med en Platinum-rating for sin bæredygtighedsindsats. 

Vi bygger fremtiden ved at hjælpe andre med at bygge deres.

title: Postdoc in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing data science projects within these consortia and the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below, with strong experience in software development.

  • Computer science (informatics)

  • Mathematics

  • Physics

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with strong analytical skills and interdisciplinary experience. Candidates with a solid data science background but lacking biological training are strongly encouraged to apply and include a statement about their motivation for this position and how they anticipate addressing this.

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in computer science (informatics), mathematics, physics, bioinformatics, or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in machine learning and statistical analysis.

  • Strong programming skills and experience using deep learning frameworks (e.g., Python, NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

  • Experience with deep learning model architectures, including autoencoders, graph neural networks, and related neural network models.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI (xAI) methods for interpreting machine learning and deep learning models.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Experience in applying deep learning to biological problems.

  • Basic understanding of human disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 09, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477

title: Fine-dining tjener til Michelin restaurant Lille Mølle
description:

  • Har minimum 1-2 års erfaring som tjener – gerne fra gastronomisk niveau

  • Er fagligt stærk, detaljeorienteret og vant til at arbejde struktureret

  • Brænder for vin og mad i samspil

Hos Lille Mølle prioriterer vi kvalitet – både i forhold til vores produkt og i vores arbejdsmiljø. Vi tror på, at den bedste service kommer fra et sted med overskud og arbejdsglæde. Er du klar til næste skridt i din tjenerkarriere – i et miljø med hjerte, faglighed og ambitioner?

title: Dagtilbud Nørresundby søger pædagog 37 timer til barselsvikariat i Vuggestuen Magnolia
description:
Om stillingen/arbejdspladsen:

Vi er en 6 år gammel vuggestue, der har til huse i Strubjerg. Vi har en dejlig stor legeplads, som vi bruger hver dag. Vores nærmiljø byder på mange spændende oplevelser, som vi benytter ugentligt.  

Vi er en personalegruppe, som har høje faglige ambitioner på børnenes vegne og vi værner om den faglige omsorgsfulde tone i den daglige opgaveløsning omkring vores kerneopgave. Vi har et godt arbejdsmiljø som vi ligeledes vægter højt. 

Vi er normeret til 40 vuggestuebørn, som er fordelt på tværs af alder på tre stuer.  Stuerne hedder "Mariehøne", "Humlebi" og "Sommerfugle".

Vi er et mangfoldigt børnehus og det er vi rigtigt glade for.  

(Bus nr. 17 holder lige udenfor døren – så vi har nemt til kollektiv trafik.)  

 

Vuggestuen Magnolia søger en anerkendende og positiv pædagog til 37 timer til et barselsvikariat fra 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt. 

Vægter du at arbejde med de mindste børn og er nærvær, tryghed og omsorg vigtige elementer i dit arbejde? Så er det måske dig, der skal være vores nye kollega. 

Er du den, der kan ræse afsted på en scooter på legepladsen og samtidig tilbyde en tryg favn, hvorfra et lille barn kan udforske verden? Brænder du for at skabe værdifulde oplevelser i børnenes hverdag og kan arbejde reflekteret og målrettet med børnegruppen, så kan det være, at du er den pædagog, der skal være i vores vuggestue.

 

Vi søger dig, som:

  • Er uddannet pædagog

  • Er fagligt nysgerrig og ønsker at udvikle pædagogisk praksis

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for fællesskabet

  • Er loyal over for fælles beslutninger og aftaler

  • Kommunikerer åbent og ærligt

  • Ser muligheder frem for begrænsninger

  • Møder børn, forældre og kollegaer med nærvær, anerkendelse og respekt

  •  


Vi kan tilbyde:

 I Vuggestuen Magnolia bliver du en del af et fællesskab, hvor vi arbejder med vores faglighed. Du bliver en del af et arbejdsfællesskab, hvor udvikling, refleksioner og faglighed vægtes højt. Vi arbejder hele tiden med at øge børnenes deltagelsesmuligheder i i forskellige børne og voksne fællesskaber og det bliver du også en stor del af. 

Vi er optaget af at skabe genkendelighed for børnene via faste rutiner. Vi er i gang med NEST og laver prøvehandlinger, som understøtter dette. Det bliver du selvfølgelig også en del af. Vi arbejder løbende med indretning af vores læringsmiljøer og tilpasser disse til vores børn. Vi arbejder med sprog i alt, hvad vi foretager os sammen med børnene

Vores hverdag er præget af ture ud af huset, ar mødes i mindre læringsgrupper, hvor der er nærvær og tryghed for det enkelte barn. Vi kan godt lide at bruge vores kroppe i de pædagogiske aktiviteter vi laver sammen med børnene.

Vi kan godt lide at være ude og gå på opdagelse i vores nærmiljø.

få en hverdag med mening, udvikling og fantastiske kollega fællesskab.

Vi øger vores aktivitet og opnormerer. Vi søger derfor en frisk og dedikeret sygeplejerske, som har lyst at være med til at udvikle fremtidens dagkirurgi. Hvor vi sammen skal sikre den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet i et sundhedsvæsen i forandring, i en tid hvor flere og flere patientforløb overgår til dag- og sammedagskirurgi.

En hverdag med helhedssygepleje

I Dagkirurgi 4 arbejder vi med korttidssygepleje og følger patienten gennem hele forløbet:

Modtagelse → Operation → Opvågning → Udskrivelse

Den helhedsorienterede tilgang giver et varieret arbejde med stor selvstændighed og tæt patientkontakt. Samtidig bidrager den til høj sygeplejefaglig kvalitet og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi har fokus på at skabe trygge, individuelle og sammenhængende patientforløb Og arbejder med Fundamentals of Care (FoC)

 

Spændende specialer og nye muligheder

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med patienter inden for:

  • Kvindesygdomme
  • Nedre mave- og tarmsygdomme
  • Urinvejskirurgi
  • Plastik og brystkirurgi 

 

Vi tilbyder
  • et spændende og varieret arbejde i et dagkirurgisk afsnit i udvikling
  • et struktureret introduktionsforløb tilpasset dine kompetencer og erfaringer
  • en engageret personalegruppe med humor, hjælpsomhed og stærkt kollegialt sammenhold
  • et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med fokus på kvalitet og patientoplevelser
  • ønskeplan med indflydelse på egen arbejdstilrettelæggelse - fri i weekender og på helligdage
  • fast undervisning hver onsdag morgen (mono- og tværfaglig undervisning)

  • Mulighed for ansættelse på 32-37 timer ugentligt.

 

Vi søger en sygeplejerske, der
  • har teknisk flair og interesse for instrumentel sygepleje og digitale løsninger
  • har lyst til at påvirke sygeplejens udvikling i et dagkirurgisk afsnit
  • trives med højt patientflow og kan bevare overblikket
  • har stærke kompetencer i planlægning, prioritering og koordinering
  • er positiv, refleksiv og løsningsorienteret
  • rr omstillingsparat og trives i en hverdag i bevægelse og konstant forandring
  • har interesse for at planlægge og implementere IT-løsninger, der styrker kvalitet og patientforløb
  • har gode kommunikations- og samarbejdsevner
  • vil bidrage aktivt til et stærkt og udviklende tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø.

Erfaring fra operation, opvågning eller dagkirurgi er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

Hvem er vi?

Vi er et afsnit med høje faglige ambitioner og et stærkt fokus på kvalitet, læring og sammenhængende patientforløb.

Vi prioriterer kompetenceudvikling højt og arbejder systematisk med læring i praksis. Undervisning, faglig sparring og simulation er en integreret del af vores hverdag.

En gang om måneden gennemfører vi simulationstræning, hvor vi træner kliniske scenarier og styrker samarbejdet på tværs af faggrupper. Det bidrager til høj patientsikkerhed, faglig udvikling og tryghed i mødet med både kendte og uforudsete situationer.

Afsnittet er uddannelsessted for medicinstuderende, sygeplejestuderende, paramedicinere og anæstesikursister, og vi ser uddannelse og videndeling som en vigtig del af vores kultur.

Hos os møder du engagerede kolleger med forskellige erfaringer og kompetencer, som alle bidrager til et stærkt fællesskab og en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

title: Critical Environment Technician
description:
Overview
Critical Environment Technician (CET) – Shift Role 
Location: 3 Sites Greater Copenhagen Area, Denmark  
Role Type: Shift-based, onsite technical operations role 

Role Summary Microsoft is seeking a Critical Environment Technician (CET) to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Microsoft datacenter infrastructure in Denmark. 
This role is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems within a 24/7 mission-critical environment. 

We offer an excellent work-life balance 
•    Two-day shifts from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. •    Two-night shifts from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. 
•    Seven days off following each rotation, in accordance with the DI agreement. 
Microsoft Culture and Expectations 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within CO+I, this mission is supported through a culture focused on safety, reliability, sustainability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. 
Employees are expected to model Microsoft values, follow approved procedures, apply STOP WORK authority when needed, and contribute to an inclusive environment where all team members can perform, grow, and succeed. 


Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities 
•    Monitor, operate, and control critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems. 
•    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance in accordance with approved EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs. 
•    Respond to incidents, support troubleshooting and recovery activities, and lead response efforts when appropriate. •    Identify and escalate safety, compliance, and operational risks in line with Microsoft standards. 
•    Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure safe and high-quality execution. 
•    Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and developing technical capability over time. 


Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
 •    Upper secondary education (vocational or general upper secondary school) or equivalent practical work experience 
•    Some prior experience in technical work, such as: industrial maintenance, electrical or HVAC installations, energy, process or production facilities, datacentres, hospitals or other demanding technical environments 
•    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
•    Ability to work rotating shift patterns in a 24/7 operational environment. 
•    Ability to communicate effectively in English. 
Preferred (but not essential) Qualifications 
•    Technical certification in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent training. 
•    Experience working with CMMS systems. •    Experience in high-availability, mission-critical, or safety-critical environments. 
•    Exposure to industrial, electrical, mechanical, cooling, or control systems.  

Direct datacenter experience is not required—we provide onboarding and support to build the necessary domain expertise. 
You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. 
If you have strong experience in similar technical environments, a passion for safety, and operations, we encourage you to apply. 

Candidate Profile 
•    The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong safety mindset, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a structured, procedure-driven environment. 
•    Microsoft encourages applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a high-performing datacenter operations team. 
Security Requirements 
Candidates must successfully complete the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and maintain ongoing compliance throughout employment.

title: Pædagoger eller pædagogiske assistenter søges til Solsikken, specialafdeling
description:
Vil du være en del af et trygt, nærværende og engageret fritidstilbud for børn og unge med særlige behov?

Solsikken søger en uddannet pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller medarbejder med relevant pædagogisk erfaring til en fast stilling på 24 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse pr. 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Solsikken er en specialafdeling og et fritidstilbud for børn og unge i alderen 10–17 år med svære generelle vanskeligheder, både fysisk og psykisk. Børnene og de unge har forskellige og komplekse støttebehov, og flere har diagnoser som ADHD, autisme og epilepsi.

Vores mål er at skabe et trygt, udviklende og inkluderende miljø, hvor børnene og de unge føler sig set, forstået og anerkendt. Vi arbejder målrettet med stærke relationer, tydelige rammer og meningsfulde fællesskaber, hvor der er plads til forskellighed og udvikling.


Vi søger dig, der

  • har en pædagogisk uddannelse eller relevant erfaring
  • har kendskab til – eller stor lyst til at arbejde med – børn og unge med særlige behov og komplekse problemstillinger
  • gerne har erfaring med ADHD, autisme, epilepsi og medicingivning
  • er indstillet på at hjælpe med personlig hygiejne og andre omsorgsopgaver
  • er anerkendende, tydelig og rolig i din pædagogiske tilgang
  • kan skabe trygge og positive relationer til børn og unge
  • kan sætte tydelige rammer og håndtere konflikter med ro og overblik
  • er fleksibel og har mod på nye opgaver i en hverdag, hvor der ofte er fart på
  • er initiativrig og har lyst til at sætte aktiviteter i gang
  • har kørekort.


Dine opgaver

Som medarbejder i Solsikken bliver du en vigtig del af børnenes og de unges hverdag. Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • støtte børnene og de unge i deres fritidsliv og sociale fællesskaber
  • planlægge og gennemføre aktiviteter, der tager udgangspunkt i den enkeltes behov og interesser
  • yde praktisk og personlig støtte i hverdagen
  • samarbejde tæt med forældre og kolleger
  • samarbejde med skole, fysioterapeuter, socialrådgivere, PPR og andre relevante samarbejdspartnere
  • deltage i de praktiske opgaver, der er nødvendige for, at huset fungerer i hverdagen.

Du får mulighed for at bringe dine egne interesser i spil – eksempelvis sport, gaming, kreative aktiviteter, friluftsliv, madlavning eller andre aktiviteter, som kan skabe glæde og engagement hos børnene og de unge.


Arbejdstid
De daglige mødetider ligger primært mellem kl. 12.30 og 16.30.
Der vil desuden være klubaftener 3 gange om måneden til kl. 21.00. 

I skoleferierne ligger arbejdstiden typisk mellem kl. 6.30 og 16.30.


Vi kan tilbyde

  • en meningsfuld arbejdsplads, hvor du gør en reel forskel for børn og unge med særlige behov
  • skønne børn og unge og engagerede forældre
  • dygtige og engagerede kolleger samt et stærkt tværfagligt samarbejde
  • en hverdag med fokus på relationer, trivsel og udvikling
  • mulighed for at præge aktiviteter og den pædagogiske hverdag
  • en arbejdsplads med høj trivsel, faglighed og arbejdsglæde.


Har vi vakt din interesse?
Er du blevet nysgerrig og har lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte leder Sergen Inekci på telefon 24 75 42 11 eller mail srin@frederikshavn.dk.

Du er også meget velkommen til at komme forbi til et uformelt besøg og høre mere om Solsikken og vores arbejde.

title: German Speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR), Part-time
description:
We recently expanded into Germany and we are now hiring a part-time Sales Development Representative. Your job is to find German companies that would be a good match for HR-ON’s software solutions for recruitment and core HR, start the conversation, and book the meeting for sales. We don’t know everything yet, and you will be part of shaping the future strategy of our German market expansion.


About the team

In the office you'll spend the most of your time with the Sales Development team: you, one German-speaking SDR and two colleagues covering Denmark. You'll also join the German Squad, consisting of six German-speaking colleagues across sales, marketing and customer success whose job is to make this market work.

With value based self-management at the core of how we work at HR-ON, you are responsible to your team as we don’t have the typical hierarchy. That means great freedom and great responsibility.


What you’ll do
  • Calling and emailing companies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, in German
  • Booking meetings for our sales team to close
  • Following up on leads from campaigns, webinars and events
  • Trying different messages and target groups, and keeping track of what actually works
  • Keeping the CRM in a state where a colleague can pick up your conversation


Do you recognise yourself?

This is an entry level position, so what matters more for this role than your previous experience is that you can say yes to the following statements:

  • I can hold a conversation with someone who wasn't expecting to hear from me, and I don't take a no personally
  • I keep asking questions until I understand, and I can explain something complicated back in the other person's words rather than my own
  • I don't need a manager checking up on me to deliver, and when I'm stuck, I ask instead of waiting
  • I get better results with a team around me, and I keep working on getting better at what I do
  • I speak and write German fluently


What we offer
  • A culture and environment that values output and impact, no matter the title or seniority. That means you can gain experience with tasks and take on responsibilities that are typically reserved for leadership in traditional organisations.
  • A thorough onboarding program and in-house sales training to give you the skills you need to thrive in your role
  • Become part of a team where we take our work seriously while still having fun.
  • Flexible working hours
  • Value-based self-management where mutual trust and transparency come first.


Practical information

Start date: as soon as possible

20 to 25 hours a week, spread how you like, as long as a decent share lands inside German office hours. The job is based in Odense, and we'd like you here at least two days a week. Exact days are agreed with your team.


How we hire

So you know what to expect when you apply:

  • Three short questions and your CV instead of a cover letter
  • A 30-minute screening call.
  • An interview with the team in Odense, including a 20-minute case you receive in advance
  • A decision within a week, and an answer to every candidate either way


Sounds like you?

We read applications as they arrive, so send yours when it is ready rather than waiting for a deadline, and we get back to every single candidate.

Click "apply" to send your application.


About us

HR-ON has grown from a start-up in Odense into one of Europe's most comprehensive HR technology providers, serving more than 600 customers, and we are still accelerating.

HR-ON covers the whole employee journey, from recruitment and onboarding through wellbeing, time registration, employee data and offboarding.

At HR-ON, employees have the freedom to manage their own working time. This means unlimited holiday and parental leave, as well as full flexibility regarding working hours and remote working.

Our employee manifesto outlines a forward-thinking approach to working life, shifting focus from time to results, from control to trust, and from hierarchy to open dialogue. We call this approach value-based self-management because it is based on trust and a shared set of values.

Read more about our Employee Manifesto HERE

title: Pædagog med kærlighed til natur, bæredygtighed og lyst til at være del af fællesskabet - Fast stilling, 32–37 timer
description:
Drømmer du om en hverdag, hvor naturen og bæredygtighed er en del af hverdagen, og børnene der stiller de spørgsmål, der får dig til at tænke nyt? Så tror vi, du vil føle dig hjemme hos os på Børnehuset Tranehaven.

Vi søger en pædagog til vores dejlige børnehus, der har lyst til at være en del af et nysgerrigt, fagligt stærkt og humorfuldt fællesskab – og som brænder for at udforske verden sammen med børnene. Vi er søger en ekstra pædagog, da vi vores mål er at have 70 % uddannet personale, derfor kan stillingen både være i vuggestuen eller børnehaven. Så skriv gerne hvad du ønsker. 

Vi holder samtaler løbende, for vi glæder os til at møde vores nye kollega.

 

Tranehaven – hvor natur, science og bæredygtighed mødes

Børnehuset Tranehaven ligger i Brøndby Kommune, og vi er en relativt ny institution (åbnet for to år siden) med fokus på natur, bæredygtighed og science. Hos os handler det ikke bare om at lære – det handler om at undre sig, undersøge og opdage sammen med børnene.

Vi arbejder med:

  • Naturen som læringsrum – skovture, udendørs eksperimenter og årstidernes forandringer
  • Bæredygtighed i praksis – fra affaldshåndtering til at forstå kredsløb
  • Science-tilgange – hvorfor flyver fugle? Hvad sker der med is, når den smelter? Vi stiller spørgsmål og finder svar sammen

Vores pædagogik bygger på nysgerrighed, relationer og fordybelse. Vi arbejder i små grupper, så der er tid til at følge børnenes interesser, skabe meningsfulde projekter og opbygge trygge relationer.

 

Vi håber, du er én der:

✅ Møder børnene med nysgerrighed, nærvær og et ægte engagement
✅ Elsker at være ude – i solskin, regn, mudder og morgendug
✅ Brænder for bæredygtighed og kan gøre det konkret for børn
✅ Ser potentialet i naturen som læringsrum og kan skabe spændende aktiviteter udenfor
✅ Kan skabe tydelige, inspirerende ugeplaner, der giver børn og voksne noget at glæde sig til
✅ Trives med at arbejde undersøgende med science – store spørgsmål fortjener seriøse svar!
✅ Er fagligt nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig selv og institutionen
✅ Kan skabe meningsfulde læringsmiljøer både inde og ude
✅ Har energi, humor og samtidig ro og overblik når det er nødvendigt

 

Vi tilbyder:

En hverdag fyldt med natur, eksperimenter, opdagelser og læring
En institution der tager bæredygtighed og science seriøst – men med legende tilgang
Et stærkt, fagligt team der arbejder nysgerrigt, anerkendende og med humor
Et hus i udvikling, hvor dine idéer og din faglighed får plads
En arbejdsplads hvor du både kan være en vigtig del af fællesskabet og samtidig være helt dig selv
☕ Kolleger der værdsætter både faglig dybde og sjov i hverdagen
⏰ Forberedelsesdag til pædagoger
️ Mulighed for 4-dages arbejdsuge

 

Praktisk information:

Stillingen:

  • Fast ansættelse, 32–37 timer om ugen
  • Kan både være i vuggestue og børnehave

Ansøgningsfrist:
Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning når du er klar

Opstart:

  • Efter aftale

Vil du vide mere?

Du er meget velkommen til at lave en aftale om at komme forbi til en lille rundvisning og en god kop kaffe, hvis du vil fornemme vores skønne hus og mærke vores pædagogik i praksis.

Rune Vang-Rydall                                  Kamilla Hansen
43286280 / 20261201                        43286280 / 20268105
Tranehaven@brondby.dk                   Tranehaven@brondby.dk

 

Børnehuset Tranehaven
Hvor nysgerrighed, natur og bæredygtighed vokser sammen

10-09-2026
 

 

Søg stillingen via 'ansøg'-knappen. Her kan du uploade din ansøgning og CV samt evt. relevant dokumentation. 

Alle interesserede ansøgere uanset alder, køn, handicap, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold opfordres til at søge stillingen.

I Brøndby Kommune er der en generel politik om, at nyansatte skal forevise straffeattest. Ved beskæftigelse og direkte kontakt med børn under 15 år, indhentes der også en børneattest.

Brøndby Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. 

Brøndby er en centralt beliggende hovedstadskommune med cirka 40.000 indbyggere. Byens puls er præget af fællesskab, mangfoldighed og en stærk idrætskultur. Vi er en kommune med kant og spændende kontraster med bolig- og erhvervsområder, skove, grønne områder og Strandparken med havet og indsøerne.

title: TEAM Coordinator for production at MotilityCount ApS
description:
MotilityCount ApS is an ambitious company with both scientific and commercial expertise in fertility. We are located in Valby, Copenhagen, have about 30 employees.

We are an international company and our ambition is to raise awareness of male fertility and enable more couples to realise their dream of having a child – "sooner rather than later". In a world of increasing fertility challenges, we know that "Every Day Counts".

The company primarily sells two products: the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test for home use and the SwimCount™ Harvester for clinical use. For each of the two product areas, we have a TEAM Coordinator in production.

As our current TEAM Coordinator for the production of SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test is retiring and in the future only wants to continue on reduced hours, we are looking for a new TEAM Coordinator who will take the lead in the daily operations and take responsibility for products and deliveries being completed on time. You therefore take responsibility for the daily coordination of our operations. The right candidate will be an active part of the production of the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test and as a playing coach creates motivation, well-being and development among the company's employees in production.

In addition to being at the forefront of production, you must be able to contribute by ultrasonic welding, applying labels, filling syringes and packing in both primary and secondary packaging on day and evening shifts, respectively.

The production manufactures goods both for stock and for specific customer orders. It is therefore important that you can show great flexibility and ensure that deadlines are met. This applies not least to specific orders to the USA, where we must comply with agreed delivery dates to our American importer and distributor, who delivers on to major American retailers and webshops, among others.

Your tasks

  • Be highly visible in production, support employees in doing their work and create direction in everyday life.

  • Handle production planning, staffing, division of work, training and follow-up on the employees' work.

  • Plan and coordinate production tasks and staffing so that deadlines are met.

  • Coordinate with production management and QA with a focus on quality, efficiency and deadlines.

  • As a playing coach, you can actively participate in the TEAM's daily production work together with 10-12 production/packaging employees.

  • Be responsible for the daily distribution of the tasks and follow-up on the TEAM's tasks and results.

  • Focus on safety, quality and proper craftsmanship.

  • Follow up on and order production materials from suppliers.

  • Contribute to a strong team spirit and good cooperation in production.

Your qualification

We imagine that you have a technical background and solid experience with tasks in a Medical Device production similar to the production at MotilityCount ApS.

You thrive in the role of playing coach, take the lead, are visible in production and motivate employees through presence and professional sparring. At the same time, you are practically oriented and ready to show how the tasks should be carried out.

You will not have personnel management, as the employee management and financial responsibility are handled by Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach.

You can read and understand technical SOPs, have knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and generally have a good understanding of technical solutions.

You are accommodating, good at listening and able to create trust. At the same time, you work in a structured way and follow the tasks all the way through – even when it is busy. You believe that the best results are created through a strong team spirit and good cooperation. IT is a natural part of your daily work.

We offer

  • A TEAM Leader-Coordinator role with daily management and coordination of 10-12 employees, where you combine professionalism with responsibility for people and processes.

  • A production in good development, where you get the opportunity to put your stamp on the direction.

  • A working day close to colleagues – you are not alone, but become part of a committed workplace where your ideas and commitment make a difference.

  • A job where we focus on making time for both work and leisure.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at:

21 44 59 19.

 Please send your application as soon as possible to Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at: jm@motilitycount.com.

title: Kompositmedarbejdere
description:
Vi søger Kompositmedarbejdere / Støbere til vores stærke team

 

Tuco Marine Group i Faaborg har travlt, og vi søger derfor dygtige komposit medarbejdere og støbere til vores stærke team, som producerer ProZero arbejdsbåde.

Arbejdsopgaverne i stillingen vil bestå af primært komposit arbejde med glasfiber og kulfiber materialer og primært med anvendelse af vacum infusions teknologi.

Kandidaten: Du har solid erfaring inden for komposit produktion. Du har evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt og samarbejde – med et godt overblik for planlægning og udførsel. Du har relevant faglig ballast som sætter dig i stand til at udføre opgaverne både selvstændigt og sammen med dine kollegaer, og evt. underleverandører. - Du har lyst til at arbejde med både og har måske også sejlads og både som din fritidsinteresse. Og er som person kvalitetsbevidst, fleksibel, initiativrig, struktureret og engageret.

Stillingen ligger i vores driftsselskab Tuco Production, hvor vi udvikler, designer og bygger både i letvægtsmaterialer til det professionelle marked. Vi har gennem de senere år lanceret en serie af professionelle både – vores ProZero-linje, som særligt henvender sig til Offshore og Workboat og Forsvars segmenterne. Vi er en virksomhed i vækst og har siden lanceringen af ProZero ansat løbende for at styrke vores allerede stærke hold.

Vi kan tilbyde en dynamisk arbejdsplads i en innovativ virksomhed, der er med helt fremme, når det kommer til udvikling inden for arbejde med maritim innovation, både når det drejer sig om Zero-emission fremdrivning, Autonomi, kompositmaterialer og andre nye og kommende teknologier.

 Vi har ambitiøse vækstmål, og tilbyder en spændende arbejdsplads og de bedste kolleger.

 Ansøgninger kan sendes til job@tuco.dk.

 

 

We are looking for Composites technicians / Molders for our strong team.

 

Tuco Marine Group in Faaborg is busy, and we are therefore looking for skilled composite technicians and molders for our strong team, producing ProZero workboats.

 

The tasks in the position will consist primarily of composite work with fiberglass and carbon fiber materials and primarily with the use of vacuum infusion technology.

 

The candidate: You have solid experience in composite production. You can work independently and collaborate - with a good overview for planning and execution. You have relevant professional ballast that enables you to carry out the work, both independently and together with your colleagues, and possibly subcontractors. - You want to work with boats and perhaps also have sailing and boats as your leisure interest. And as a person is quality-conscious, flexible, proactive, structured, and committed.

 

The position is in our operating company Tuco Production, where we develop, design and build boats in lightweight materials for the professional market. In recent years, we have launched a series of professional boats – our ProZero line, which is particularly aimed at the Offshore and Workboat and Defense segments. We are a growing company and since the launch of ProZero have continuously hired to strengthen our already strong team.

 

We can offer a dynamic workplace in an innovative company that is at the forefront when it comes to development within work with maritime innovation, both when it comes to Zero-emission propulsion, Autonomy, composite materials and other new and upcoming technologies.

 

We have ambitious growth targets and offer an exciting workplace and the best colleagues.

 

Applications can be sent to job@tuco.dk.

title: PhD Stipend in Intelligent Industrial Energy Systems, Physics-informed AI, digital twins and advanced control
description:
Help build the systems that will electrify industry
Industrial energy systems are about to change fundamentally. For more than a century, industrial processes have been designed as isolated, deterministic systems. You model them, you optimize them, you operate them. That paradigm is breaking down. As electricity replaces fossil fuels, industrial systems must operate under fundamentally new conditions: fluctuating renewable energy, dynamic electricity prices, and increasing system complexity.

In the future, industrial energy systems will not simply run.

  • They will understand themselves.
  • They will learn from data.
  • They will anticipate and adapt.
  • They will optimize continuously.

At Aalborg University, we are starting to build the scientific foundations for those systems. We are looking for a PhD researcher who wants to be part of that.

The stipend is open for appointment from 15 September 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

What this PhD is really about
This PhD focuses on modelling and controlling electrified industrial thermal systems under real-world conditions. The work is embedded in a collaborative research project with industrial partners, providing access to realistic system configurations, experimental setups and operational data. The scientific ambition is to develop methods that combine physical models and data-driven approaches for adaptive, real-time operation of complex energy systems. Applications such as drying processes serve as test cases, but the goal is to establish methodologies that extend across industrial thermal systems more broadly.

How do we create industrial energy systems that combine physics and data to become adaptive, autonomous and trustworthy?
To get there, you will work at the intersection of thermal energy systems, machine learning and scientific AI, system modelling and identification, as well as optimization and control.

Your work will focus on developing new methods that integrate first-principles models with data-driven learning, supported by reduced-order representations and designed for real-time optimization and control. In essence, this is about physics-informed AI-approaches where physical insight and data reinforce each other rather than compete.

The ambition is to move beyond abstract or idealized solutions. Think digital twins that are not just conceptual, but genuinely useful in practice. Think control systems that can operate robustly under uncertainty, rather than relying on simplified assumptions.

The systems you will be working with are real world, industrial scale energy systems rather than simplified lab set-ups. They include high-temperature, high-power applications, including heat pumps, thermal storage, and complex process units, where both physical understanding and intelligent control are essential.

What you will do
Your day-to-day research will move between theory, modelling and real systems.

  • You will build mathematical and physics-based models of complex thermal systems.
  • You will develop reduced order representations enabling real-time implementation suited for online optimization of operating conditions and control.
  • You will combine the models with data driven learning to adapt to varying operating conditions.
  • You will design control strategies that can operate under real-world constraints.

Some of your work will be purely theoretical. Some of it will be validated against experimental setups and industrial data. You will publish your work, present it internationally, and build a research profile that is relevant far beyond this specific application.

The environment you will step into
You will not be placed inside a narrow, predefined research group. Instead, you will work across a small, complementary team that brings together different pieces of the puzzle:

thermal systems and physical modelling advanced control and system-level thinking industrial electrification and future energy technologies

This is an emerging collaboration, not a finished structure.  This means that you are not just executing a predefined roadmap. You are helping shape the direction.

Your supervisors
You will be supported by a team with different strengths, scientifically and personally.

Henrik Sørensen is Head of Section and your main supervisor. His focus is not only on research, but on building researchers. He will push you, give you space, and expect you to grow into an independent scientist.

Henrik C. Pedersen is Vice Head of Research and one of the key profiles within modelling and control at AAU. He will challenge your thinking, sharpen your methods and connect your work to a broader scientific context.

Anna Lyhne Jensen represents the next generation of energy researchers.
Her work focuses on electrification of industrial processes and future thermal systems, and she is deeply engaged in the green transition. She will be your closest collaborator in many parts of the project.

Together, the team is not uniform, and that is exactly the point. No single discipline can solve this problem.

Who you are
You likely have a background in energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control, applied mathematics, physics or a related field.

But more importantly, we are looking for someone who:

  • Has a strong curiosity about how complex systems actually work.
  • Is comfortable with mathematical modelling and analytical thinking.
  • Is motivated to combine physical insight with data-drive methods.
  • Enjoys building models and methods – not just analyzing existing ones.
  • Has the ambition and persistence to tackle difficult problems and carry them through.

This is a demanding PhD. It requires both independence and engagement, and a willingness to work at the intersection of disciplines. You don’t need to know everything from the start - but you should have a clear drive to develop expertise and contribute at a high scientific level.

What you get out of it
This PhD is not just about writing three papers and moving on. It is about building a profile that sits at the intersection of energy systems, AI & modelling and optimization & control. That combination is rare, and extremely valuable, both in academia and industry.

  • You will work with real systems, real data and real problems.
  • You will collaborate with industry.
  • You will be part of the broader European research landscape in energy and sustainability.

And you will have a high degree of freedom to shape your own direction.

Why this matters
Industrial heat is one of the hardest parts of the green transition. Electrification alone is not enough. If we cannot control and optimize these systems intelligently, we will not unlock their full potential. This PhD is about contributing to these missing pieces.

Expected starting date is 15 September 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Interested?
If you want to work on something that is technically challenging, scientifically interesting, and actually matters — we would like to hear from you. Applications should include a CV, transcripts and a short motivation.

For further information, feel free to contact:

Henrik Sørensen, hs@energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at: the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus.
AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
