title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 09, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

title: Critical Environment Technician
description:
Overview
Critical Environment Technician (CET) – Shift Role 
Location: 3 Sites Greater Copenhagen Area, Denmark  
Role Type: Shift-based, onsite technical operations role 

Role Summary Microsoft is seeking a Critical Environment Technician (CET) to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Microsoft datacenter infrastructure in Denmark. 
This role is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems within a 24/7 mission-critical environment. 

We offer an excellent work-life balance 
•    Two-day shifts from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. •    Two-night shifts from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. 
•    Seven days off following each rotation, in accordance with the DI agreement. 
Microsoft Culture and Expectations 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within CO+I, this mission is supported through a culture focused on safety, reliability, sustainability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. 
Employees are expected to model Microsoft values, follow approved procedures, apply STOP WORK authority when needed, and contribute to an inclusive environment where all team members can perform, grow, and succeed. 


Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities 
•    Monitor, operate, and control critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems. 
•    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance in accordance with approved EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs. 
•    Respond to incidents, support troubleshooting and recovery activities, and lead response efforts when appropriate. •    Identify and escalate safety, compliance, and operational risks in line with Microsoft standards. 
•    Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure safe and high-quality execution. 
•    Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and developing technical capability over time. 


Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
 •    Upper secondary education (vocational or general upper secondary school) or equivalent practical work experience 
•    Some prior experience in technical work, such as: industrial maintenance, electrical or HVAC installations, energy, process or production facilities, datacentres, hospitals or other demanding technical environments 
•    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
•    Ability to work rotating shift patterns in a 24/7 operational environment. 
•    Ability to communicate effectively in English. 
Preferred (but not essential) Qualifications 
•    Technical certification in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent training. 
•    Experience working with CMMS systems. •    Experience in high-availability, mission-critical, or safety-critical environments. 
•    Exposure to industrial, electrical, mechanical, cooling, or control systems.  

Direct datacenter experience is not required—we provide onboarding and support to build the necessary domain expertise. 
You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. 
If you have strong experience in similar technical environments, a passion for safety, and operations, we encourage you to apply. 

Candidate Profile 
•    The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong safety mindset, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a structured, procedure-driven environment. 
•    Microsoft encourages applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a high-performing datacenter operations team. 
Security Requirements 
Candidates must successfully complete the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and maintain ongoing compliance throughout employment.

title: German Speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR), Part-time
description:
We recently expanded into Germany and we are now hiring a part-time Sales Development Representative. Your job is to find German companies that would be a good match for HR-ON’s software solutions for recruitment and core HR, start the conversation, and book the meeting for sales. We don’t know everything yet, and you will be part of shaping the future strategy of our German market expansion.


About the team

In the office you'll spend the most of your time with the Sales Development team: you, one German-speaking SDR and two colleagues covering Denmark. You'll also join the German Squad, consisting of six German-speaking colleagues across sales, marketing and customer success whose job is to make this market work.

With value based self-management at the core of how we work at HR-ON, you are responsible to your team as we don’t have the typical hierarchy. That means great freedom and great responsibility.


What you’ll do
  • Calling and emailing companies across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, in German
  • Booking meetings for our sales team to close
  • Following up on leads from campaigns, webinars and events
  • Trying different messages and target groups, and keeping track of what actually works
  • Keeping the CRM in a state where a colleague can pick up your conversation


Do you recognise yourself?

This is an entry level position, so what matters more for this role than your previous experience is that you can say yes to the following statements:

  • I can hold a conversation with someone who wasn't expecting to hear from me, and I don't take a no personally
  • I keep asking questions until I understand, and I can explain something complicated back in the other person's words rather than my own
  • I don't need a manager checking up on me to deliver, and when I'm stuck, I ask instead of waiting
  • I get better results with a team around me, and I keep working on getting better at what I do
  • I speak and write German fluently


What we offer
  • A culture and environment that values output and impact, no matter the title or seniority. That means you can gain experience with tasks and take on responsibilities that are typically reserved for leadership in traditional organisations.
  • A thorough onboarding program and in-house sales training to give you the skills you need to thrive in your role
  • Become part of a team where we take our work seriously while still having fun.
  • Flexible working hours
  • Value-based self-management where mutual trust and transparency come first.


Practical information

Start date: as soon as possible

20 to 25 hours a week, spread how you like, as long as a decent share lands inside German office hours. The job is based in Odense, and we'd like you here at least two days a week. Exact days are agreed with your team.


How we hire

So you know what to expect when you apply:

  • Three short questions and your CV instead of a cover letter
  • A 30-minute screening call.

title: TEAM Coordinator for production at MotilityCount ApS
description:
MotilityCount ApS is an ambitious company with both scientific and commercial expertise in fertility. We are located in Valby, Copenhagen, have about 30 employees.

We are an international company and our ambition is to raise awareness of male fertility and enable more couples to realise their dream of having a child – "sooner rather than later". In a world of increasing fertility challenges, we know that "Every Day Counts".

The company primarily sells two products: the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test for home use and the SwimCount™ Harvester for clinical use. For each of the two product areas, we have a TEAM Coordinator in production.

As our current TEAM Coordinator for the production of SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test is retiring and in the future only wants to continue on reduced hours, we are looking for a new TEAM Coordinator who will take the lead in the daily operations and take responsibility for products and deliveries being completed on time. You therefore take responsibility for the daily coordination of our operations. The right candidate will be an active part of the production of the SwimCount™ Sperm Quality Test and as a playing coach creates motivation, well-being and development among the company's employees in production.

In addition to being at the forefront of production, you must be able to contribute by ultrasonic welding, applying labels, filling syringes and packing in both primary and secondary packaging on day and evening shifts, respectively.

The production manufactures goods both for stock and for specific customer orders. It is therefore important that you can show great flexibility and ensure that deadlines are met. This applies not least to specific orders to the USA, where we must comply with agreed delivery dates to our American importer and distributor, who delivers on to major American retailers and webshops, among others.

Your tasks

  • Be highly visible in production, support employees in doing their work and create direction in everyday life.

  • Handle production planning, staffing, division of work, training and follow-up on the employees' work.

  • Plan and coordinate production tasks and staffing so that deadlines are met.

  • Coordinate with production management and QA with a focus on quality, efficiency and deadlines.

  • As a playing coach, you can actively participate in the TEAM's daily production work together with 10-12 production/packaging employees.

  • Be responsible for the daily distribution of the tasks and follow-up on the TEAM's tasks and results.

  • Focus on safety, quality and proper craftsmanship.

  • Follow up on and order production materials from suppliers.

  • Contribute to a strong team spirit and good cooperation in production.

Your qualification

We imagine that you have a technical background and solid experience with tasks in a Medical Device production similar to the production at MotilityCount ApS.

You thrive in the role of playing coach, take the lead, are visible in production and motivate employees through presence and professional sparring. At the same time, you are practically oriented and ready to show how the tasks should be carried out.

You will not have personnel management, as the employee management and financial responsibility are handled by Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach.

You can read and understand technical SOPs, have knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and generally have a good understanding of technical solutions.

You are accommodating, good at listening and able to create trust. At the same time, you work in a structured way and follow the tasks all the way through – even when it is busy. You believe that the best results are created through a strong team spirit and good cooperation. IT is a natural part of your daily work.

We offer

  • A TEAM Leader-Coordinator role with daily management and coordination of 10-12 employees, where you combine professionalism with responsibility for people and processes.

  • A production in good development, where you get the opportunity to put your stamp on the direction.

  • A working day close to colleagues – you are not alone, but become part of a committed workplace where your ideas and commitment make a difference.

  • A job where we focus on making time for both work and leisure.

 Interested?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at:

21 44 59 19.

 Please send your application as soon as possible to Co-Founder Jacob Møllenbach at: jm@motilitycount.com.

title: Executive Assistant to the Secretary General (maternity cover)
description:
Are you a strategic thinker, structured and with exceptional execution and communication skills? And do you have experience with executive and strategic support to senior management and knowledge of humanitarian and global affairs? We are looking for an experienced, proactive, extrovert and solutions oriented Executive Assistant to the Secretary General of the Danish Refugee Council (DRC). You will support the Secretary General in her daily work, work closely with the DRC Executive Management Team and engage with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

About the job

The office of the Secretary General is a small dynamic team, supporting the Secretary General, the Executive Management Team, the Board of Directors, and the Council of DRC. The office also supports DRC’s overall organisational processes and its overall strategy, provides management and administrative support to the Secretary General, and organises global staff meetings. The office works and coordinates closely with departments in headquarters as well as DRC offices across the world.

 

Your key responsibilities will include:

·         Day-to-day comprehensive executive support and advice to the Secretary General, including on external engagements, positioning and communication, in close coordination with relevant teams. Liaising and communicating clearly and professionally on behalf of the Secretary General internally in DRC and with external stakeholders.

·         Support to the Executive Management Team (EMT), including preparation of agendas and presentations, decision-making documents and minutes, follow-up to decisions, and preparation of regular bilateral meetings between the SG and EMT members, including agenda setting. 

·         Coordinating and advising on processes for preparing the Secretary General’s external engagements, including drafting and proof reading of products (briefs, talking points, presentations etc.) for the Secretary General, and ensure timely and efficient follow-ups and minutes, and feedback to relevant teams.

·         Making sure that the Secretary General receives information requiring her attention and action and managing the Secretary General’s calendar.

·         Identify opportunities to simplify processes and strengthen ways of working through digital tools, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

·         Ensuring expense management in Microsoft Dynamics, related to SG travels, events and meetings (primary task of student assistant).

·         Ensuring legalisation of documents required across the organisation, including notarisation, apostilles, and coordination with embassies and translation services (primary task of student assistant).

 

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to have:

·         A relevant master’s degree in international relations, political science or similar.

·         Excellent collaboration, analytical, organisational and communication skills, a flexible and solution-oriented attitude, and a structured and independent way of working with the ability to see the bigger picture while maintaining a strong attention to detail and high-quality deliverables.

·         Ability to maintain overview of a broad operational and political portfolio, advise on priorities and ensure timely execution and follow-up.

·         Solid knowledge of humanitarian affairs and operations, as well as international relations and developments impacting the work of DRC.

·         Experience in interacting with many different stakeholders, including high level, ideally from diplomacy and/or external relations from a global organisation.

·         Ability to deliver high-quality analytical inputs, and to draft complex briefing materials, talking points, and political or legal reports in fast-paced, high-pressure environment is required.

·         Full professional proficiency in Danish and English. Basic knowledge of French and/or Spanish is desirable.

 

All employees should master DRC's core competencies:

Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. 

Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. 

Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. 

Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. 

Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

We offer

An interesting workplace with excellent colleagues and plenty of scope for contribution with your own ideas. The possibility of working closely with and supporting the Secretary General and the Executive Management Team, as well as colleagues across our global organisation.

Contract length: 9 months with the possibility of extension (maternity cover)

Work location: Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken station

Start date: mid-November 2026 or the soonest hereafter

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and AC. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply. Salary will be determined based on qualifications.

Please note that you need to have the right to work in Denmark (through nationality or existing work visa) in order to be considered for this role. 

 

Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV in English (no longer than four pages) as well as degree certificate. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 2 September 2026. We expect to conduct interviews in September.

Further information 

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact Vibeke Bach Madsen, Corporate Strategic Advisor in the Secretary General’s Office: vibeke.bach.madsen@drc.ngo. We will do our best to respond to as many inquiries as possible.

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo.

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

title: Project & Business Coordinator
description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

title: Research Assistant Positions in Development of AI-based Decision Support
description:
Applications are invited for two part-time research assistant positions with SDU Health Informatics and Technology (HIT), The Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), Odense. Both positions are for 1 years at 25% (9,25 hours/week). The planned starting date for the positions is October 1, 2026.

 

Tasks

Both research assistant positions will focus on development of AI-based decision support. One position will be related to a joint project with Hospital Sønderjylland (Sønderborg) on personalized cardiovascular risk prediction and diagnostic support for patients with advanced kidney disease. The other position will be related to a joint project with Lillebælt Hospital (Vejle) on detection of smoking status and symptoms for lung cancer patients.

 

Ideal candidates

To qualify for the positions, you must hold a M.Sc. degree in software engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, or a related discipline.

The ideal candidates will have many of the following competences.

  • artificial intelligence experience (including explainability and interpretability)

  • experience in development of AI-augmented decision support tools

  • experience in interdisciplinary work

  • experience in working with external stakeholders and domain experts

  • knowledge of the health domain

 

About MMMI and SDU HIT

MMMI is an internationally recognized research department that conducts research within robotics, drone technology, artificial intelligence, I4.0, software engineering as well as health and energy informatics.

SDU HIT conducts interdisciplinary research related to data driven health technology in close collaboration with experts from various fields. There is a strong emphasis on the development of high TRL systems related to intelligent monitoring and decision support; predictive models for prevention, early detection, diagnosis, treatment, and prognosis; digital health systems offering novel personalized data collection, treatment plans and interventions. SDU HIT has research activities in areas such as geriatrics, mental health, compassion, cancer, cardiology, kidney disease, osteoporosis, and multiple sclerosis.

 

Additional information

For further information about the positions, please contact Professor Uffe Kock Wiil, phone +45 6011 3565, email ukwiil@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications, if you have any.

  • Publications most relevant for the position (max. 2).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file).

Read about the Assessment and selection process.

This appointment as a research assistant is part-time and temporary for an initial 1-year period, and the preferred start date is from October 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. 

Employment as a research assistant requires qualifications at minimum master’s level (equivalent to a Danish master’s degree) at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for research assistant as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. title: Postdoc Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more postdoc positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a two-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

  • State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

  • Real-time perception.

  • Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

  • Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

  • Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the appointment, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center’s project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect

We expect that you hold a PhD degree or expect to be awarded one before the start date, within engineering, robotics, computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

  • Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

  • Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

  • Perception and machine learning for robotics.

  • Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

  • UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

  • A research statement may be included.

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein.

title: PhD Positions in Autonomous Drone Flight in Confined Spaces for Wind Turbine Inspection
description:
The SDU UAS Center, part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, invites applications for one or more PhD positions on autonomous flight in confined and cluttered environments for multi-rotor drones. The positions are for a three-year employment with a flexible start date.

 

What We Offer
The successful candidates will become part of the SDU UAS Center, where we conduct cutting-edge research in civilian drone technologies and future drone applications in critical sectors, such as agriculture, inspection, energy, and healthcare. At the heart of our mission is the creation of groundbreaking drone solutions that address key societal challenges. We are committed to fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment where creativity flourishes. We often collaborate closely with world-leading companies, some of which are part of the vibrant robotic startup community around Odense.

The positions are tied to the development of an Automated Service Inspection (ASI) system for wind turbines, carried out in close collaboration with Vestas. Wind energy is a cornerstone of the green transition, yet the industry depends heavily on manual inspections and a shrinking pool of service technicians. Autonomous drones that can fly safely inside and around turbine structures are a key enabler for scalable, data-driven maintenance, promising less downtime, improved safety, and higher energy production across a growing global fleet.

 

Work Area
The successful candidates will conduct research and development within autonomous flight in confined spaces, where safety and robustness under real-world conditions are paramount. Flying close to and inside turbine structures, such as the tower interior, raises fundamental research challenges: navigation without reliable GNSS, perception in geometrically complex environments, and safe motion planning within centimetres of critical infrastructure. Concretely, the work will include the following:

  • State estimation and localisation in GNSS-denied, confined environments (visual-inertial odometry (VIO), simultaneous localisation and mapping (SLAM), sensor fusion).

  • Real-time perception.

  • Motion planning and control for safe, agile flight in close proximity to obstacles and infrastructure.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads tailored to confined-space inspection, from concept and mechanical/electronics integration to flight-ready platforms.

  • Integration of autonomy with onboard inspection payloads (cameras, microphones) and existing turbine data.

  • Operation and flight testing of multi-rotor UAS, including experiments at turbine sites.

During the PhD studies, the successful candidates will also have the opportunity to work on related autonomy challenges across the center's project portfolio, where autonomous flight under demanding real-world conditions is a recurring theme.

The positions may involve co-supervising related student projects. The candidates will be part of the SDU UAS Center and are expected to participate in the center's project portfolio and outreach activities.

 

We Expect
We expect that you hold an MSc, or expect to complete one before the start date, in engineering, robotics, or computer science, or another related field. You do not need to cover every area below, but you should have experience with, and a genuine interest in, some of the following:

  • Research and development within autonomous navigation, state estimation, or motion planning for robots or UAS.

  • Research and development within UAS platforms, subsystems, and payloads.

  • Prototyping of drones and payloads (mechanical design, electronics, systems integration).

  • Perception and machine learning for robotics.

  • Software design and development (C, C++, Python), including real-time and embedded systems.

  • UAS operations (experiments, piloting).

We furthermore expect that you publish findings at recognised international conferences and in top-ranked, peer-reviewed journals.

For certain projects and tasks at the Drone Labs at HCA Airport, a security check by relevant authorities and a driving license are required.

For further information, please contact Prof. Anders Lyhne Christensen (andc@mmmi.sdu.dk) and Associate Prof. Robert Ladig (rola@mmmi.sdu.dk).

We look forward to receiving your application.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • References may be included, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

-

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. title: Project assistant: Formulation development of novel tuberculosis compounds into long acting injectables at SDU in Odense
description:
A two-year position within pharmaceutical sciences focusing on formulation development and biopharmaceutical understanding of the performance of novel compounds for the treatment of tuberculosis is available at the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Pharmacy in the pharmacy research group. 

Starting date: 01 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Project background

Long-acting injectables (LAIs) are pharmaceutical products intended for weekly, monthly or with an even lower administration frequency, which provides a continued drug release and thereby a steady exposure of the delivered compound. LAIs are typically administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) as oil solutions, in situ forming gels, microspheres, implants, micro- or nanosuspensions, with focus on suspensions in the present work. For individuals suffering of tuberculosis LAIs can provide a huge benefit in disease treatment, due to the long duration time the disease requires. 

LAIs have, with huge clinical success, been applied in the treatment of antipsychotic conditions and the area contains some of the most successful LAI formulations seen from a therapeutic perspective. In the 1960s, oil-based parenteral depot formulations, containing antipsychotics, were introduced in the clinical practice. Since then, the micro- and nanosuspension technology has significantly advanced and many of the more recent LAIs are nano-or microsuspensions. Hence, this is currently one of the important technologies in the field of LAIs and also the focus of the present project. 

The common approach to manipulate the performance of LAI suspensions release rate relies on changing particle size distribution of the crystalline API. This strategy is fundamentally explained by the Noyes-Whitney equation, which describes the dissolution rate of particles in sink conditions. According to the Noyes-Whitney equation, the dissolution rate is proportional to the total surface area of the drug particles. Some commercial products confirms thus and also a few academical studies have reported correlations between the particle size and the in vivo release, hence it is clearly a point that should be clarified when working with a new compound for a LAI suspension. Aside from particle size, other formulation aspects can significantly impact performance, such as formulation composition and the level of flocculation. In addition, API crystal form properties, such as morphology, level of amorphous contents and residual solvent in the API, may have a significant impact on dissolution, indicating that the selection of version and form is crucial not only for manufacturability and stability purposes, but also for performance.

This project aligns closely with Quality by Design (QbD) principles, emphasizing risk assessment, formulation understanding, and robust design space development, but systematically investigating the formulation impact on in vivo release of LAI suspensions in nonclinical models using the obtained data to generate a risk matrix for in vivo impact of potential particle size variations. A successful outcome of this project will provide a formulation that can be taken to clinical trials for the treatment of tuberculosis with the tools to understand the biopharmaceutical performance of LAI suspensions with the relevant compounds supported by quality tools on the stability. 

The work will be conducted in close cooperation with Professor René Holm and other colleagues working on the project.

Qualifications

  • We are looking for a candidate with a strong interest in working with pharmaceutical formulation and evaluation focused on formulation and characterization of suspensions. 

  • The candidate will hold a BSc, a M.Sc. in pharmacy, chemistry, or closely related area. 

  • Previous experiences with one or more of the following are considered an advantage: 

    • formulation design of suspensions, 

    • particle size characterization, 

    • chemical stability studies,

    •  bioanalysis, and 

    • in vivo studies.

The candidate must be independent and fluent in English both orally and written. 

For further information about the position please contact Professor René Holm (reho@sdu.dk).

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Your role

As a student assistant in Architecture & Technology, you will be part of a dynamic team that includes architects across multiple domains. In this role, you will support the Architecture & Technology team in documenting our architecture landscape and develop guidelines and standards for architecture documentation. You will work closely with Enterprise, System and Application Architects and gain first-hand experience of how architecture is used to guide technology decisions across a growing organisation.

  • Prepare presentations, reports, and decision material for management and stakeholders

  • Relevant Background: You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software/IT Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Collaborative Attitude: You enjoy working with others and are comfortable interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Interest in Architecture & Technology: You are curious about how organisations design, govern, and evolve their technology landscape

  • Structured Working Style: You have an eye for detail and enjoy creating order, structure, and clarity in documentation and information

  • Analytical and Curious Mindset: You have a strong curiosity for technology, and enjoy analysing complex topics, identifying patterns, and creating structure and clarity from information

  • Proactive Approach: You take initiative, ask questions, and are not afraid to explore new topics independently while seeking guidance when needed

Through this role, you will gain practical experience with enterprise, system, and application architecture, on-premises technologies, and technology strategy. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced architects and technology professionals while contributing to initiatives that support Nordic RCC's mission and the green energy transition.

The role is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience, allowing you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world environment while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The position will require approximately 10-15 hours per week, depending on your study workload. We are flexible during exam periods and expect that you have at least 1½ - 2 years left of your studies.

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 25 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

title: Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice
description:
Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Nørrebro)

Position: Full-Time (37 hours / week)

Salary: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Diamond Slice

At Diamond Slice, we bring proper New York slice shop culture to Copenhagen. We elevate the humble slice with high-hydration sourdough, top-tier seasonal local ingredients, natural wines, craft beers, and cocktails—all served in a fast-paced, high-energy, welcoming neighborhood environment.  We pride ourselves on exceptional quality, great hospitality, and an unpretentious vibe.

We are growing and looking for a driven Front of House Manager to lead our floor operations, nurture our team culture, and deliver outstanding guest experiences.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

As FOH Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day guest experience, lead shift execution, and serve as a key operational anchor for both our daily service and special events.

  • FOH Leadership & Experience: Take ownership of the Front of House, ensuring smooth service flow, excellent atmosphere, and high operational standards.

  • Team Coaching & Motivation: Train, mentor, and inspire the FOH team to build a high-performing, friendly, and efficient service squad.

  • Guest Communication: Serve as the primary face and voice for guest interactions, handling feedback, special requests, and inquiries with warmth and professionalism.

  • Festivals & Events Logistics: Play a central, hands-on role in planning and executing logistics for outdoor festivals, pop-ups, and special catering events.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced hospitality leader who takes initiative, and thrives with autonomy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in hospitality (with proven leadership or supervisory experience preferred).

  • Autonomy & Problem Solving: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership to solve operational challenges independently.

  • Assertive Communication: Unafraid to speak up, bring issues to the table, and constructively challenge the status quo to make operations better.

  • Feedback Culture: Skilled and comfortable with both giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback with colleagues and leadership.

  • Guest-Centric Mindset: Genuinely loves host culture, high-energy environments, and personal interactions with guests.

  • Schedule Availability: Fully comfortable working evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month, aligned with your experience.

  • Flexible Schedule: High degree of scheduling flexibility, provided operations run smoothly and team coverage is secure.

  • Autonomous Role: Real freedom to shape FOH operations and make your mark on our growing brand.

  • Great Culture: A fast-paced, supportive, and passionate workplace with high standards and great pizza.

How to Apply

Ready to join the Diamond Slice team?

Please submit your CV along with a short introduction telling us about yourself and why you'd be a great fit for Diamond Slice to: work@diamondslice.dk

Note! Applications must include: "Diamond Slice FOH Manager" in the subject line to be considered.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

title: Køkken souschef søges til Muban Thai Roskilde
description:
KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL THAIRESTAURANT

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret køkken souschef, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift i vores thairestaurant.

Du bliver en central person i køkkenet og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og resten af teamet. Vi leder efter dig, der har passion for det thailandske køkken, tager ansvar og kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt.

Om restauranten

Vi er en thairestaurant med fokus på autentiske smage, gode råvarer og retter tilberedt med respekt for det traditionelle thailandske køkken.

I køkkenet arbejder vi blandt andet med wokretter, curries, nudler, risretter og forskellige klassiske thailandske specialiteter. For os er kvalitet, smag og konsistens afgørende, og vi lægger stor vægt på, at gæsterne får den samme gode oplevelse hver gang.

Restauranten tilbyder både servering i restauranten og takeaway, og derfor kræver hverdagen et køkken, hvor samarbejde, planlægning og effektivitet går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som køkken souschef vil du blandt andet:

  • Støtte køkkenchefen i den daglige ledelse og koordinering af køkkenet

  • Tage ansvar for køkkendriften, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

  • Koordinere arbejdsopgaver og sikre et effektivt flow under travl service

  • Sikre, at retterne lever op til restaurantens krav til smag, kvalitet og præsentation

  • Deltage aktivt i tilberedning, produktion og mise en place

  • Planlægge prep og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

  • Introducere, oplære og støtte nye medarbejdere

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en positiv arbejdskultur i køkkenet

  • Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lagerbeholdning og korrekt opbevaring af råvarer

  • Arbejde aktivt med at begrænse madspild og sikre et fornuftigt vareforbrug

  • Overholde og følge gældende regler for hygiejne, egenkontrol og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Bidrage med idéer til udvikling og forbedring af retter og menuer

  • Hjælpe med at sikre en stabil og velfungerende køkkendrift – også når der er ekstra travlt

Vi søger dig, der

  • Har relevant erfaring fra et professionelt køkken

  • Gerne har erfaring med thailandsk eller anden asiatisk gastronomi

  • Har interesse for eller erfaring med at lede og koordinere et køkkenteam

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig fungerer godt som en del af et hold

  • Er struktureret, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan bevare roen og prioritere opgaver i travle perioder

  • Har fokus på kvalitet og ensartethed i køkkenet

  • Gerne har kendskab til woktilberedning, curries og traditionelle thailandske smage

  • Har forståelse for køkkenhygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider og arbejdsopgaver

  • Kan kommunikere på engelsk. Kendskab til thai er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen

  • En vigtig rolle med ansvar og mulighed for indflydelse

  • Et arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde, kvalitet og god energi

  • Mulighed for at arbejde professionelt med thailandsk gastronomi

  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Varierende arbejdsdage og ansvar i den daglige køkkendrift

  • Fleksibel planlægning af vagter

  • Løn efter erfaring og kvalifikationer

Vi søger en souschef, som ikke er bange for at tage fat, og som gerne vil være med til at udvikle både køkkenet og teamet.

ENGLISH

KITCHEN SOUS CHEF WANTED FOR THAI RESTAURANT

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Kitchen Sous Chef to become an important part of the daily operation of our Thai restaurant.

As Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. We are looking for someone who is passionate about Thai cuisine, takes responsibility and is able to stay organised and focused in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

About the restaurant

We are a Thai restaurant focused on authentic flavours, quality ingredients and dishes prepared with respect for traditional Thai cuisine.

Our kitchen prepares a variety of dishes, including wok dishes, curries, noodles, rice dishes and classic Thai specialities. Quality, flavour and consistency are very important to us, and we aim to provide our guests with a great experience every time they visit or order from us.

We offer both dine-in service and takeaway, which means that teamwork, planning and efficiency are essential parts of our daily kitchen operation.

Your main responsibilities

As Kitchen Sous Chef, your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the Head Chef with the daily management and coordination of the kitchen

  • Taking responsibility for kitchen operations when the Head Chef is not present

  • Coordinating tasks and maintaining an efficient workflow during busy service periods

  • Ensuring consistent standards of taste, quality and presentation

  • Taking an active part in food preparation, production and mise en place

  • Planning prep work and distributing tasks among kitchen staff

  • Training, supporting and assisting new kitchen employees

  • Contributing to strong teamwork and a positive working environment

  • Managing deliveries, stock levels and correct storage of ingredients

  • Helping reduce food waste and maintaining efficient use of ingredients

  • Ensuring compliance with food hygiene and food safety procedures

  • Contributing ideas for new dishes and menu development

  • Helping maintain an organised and efficient kitchen during both normal and busy service periods

About you

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has relevant experience from a professional kitchen

  • Preferably has experience with Thai or other Asian cuisine

  • Has experience with, or an interest in, supervising and coordinating kitchen staff

  • Can work independently while also being a strong team player

  • Is organised, reliable and responsible

  • Can remain calm and prioritise tasks during busy periods

  • Has a strong focus on quality and consistency

  • Preferably has knowledge of wok cooking, curries and traditional Thai flavour profiles

  • Understands food hygiene and food safety requirements

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and responsibilities

  • Can communicate in English. Knowledge of Thai is an advantage but is not required.

We offer

  • A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

  • An important role with responsibility and influence on daily kitchen operations

  • A professional and informal working environment focused on teamwork and quality

  • The opportunity to work with authentic Thai cuisine

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Varied responsibilities and working days

  • Flexible shift planning

  • Salary based on experience and qualifications

We are looking for a Sous Chef who enjoys taking responsibility, working as part of a team and contributing to the continued development of both the kitchen and the restaurant.
