title: Senior Manager Account Management (m/w/x) (Account-Manager/in)
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung

Arvato ist ein innovativer und global führender 3PL-Dienstleister im Bereich Supply Chain Management und E-Commerce. Mit 20.000 Teammitgliedern an über 100 Standorten fokussieren wir uns auf die Branchen Consumer Products, Tech, Healthcare, Automotive and Publisher.

Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das auf Zusammenarbeit, Respekt, Engagement und Neugier basiert, in dem du wächst, deine Ideen einbringst und einen Unterschied machen kannst. Sei Teil des Teams, das Logistik-Exzellenz liefert und globale Lieferketten gestaltet. Denn Arbeiten bei Arvato heißt: Together, we’re on it.

Stellenbeschreibung

Du möchtest gemeinsam mit deinem Team nachhaltige Kundenerfolge gestalten und Verantwortung für strategisch wichtige Accounts übernehmen? An unserem Standort in Heideloh/Großzöberitz (Großraum Leipzig/Halle) arbeitest du als Senior Manager Account Management (m/w/x) an der Weiterentwicklung internationaler Kundenbeziehungen und gestaltest aktiv die Zukunft unserer E-Commerce- und Logistiklösungen. Dabei förderst du Zusammenarbeit, entwickelst Potenziale im Team und schaffst Klarheit für gemeinsame Erfolge. Are you on it?

- Strategische Kundenentwicklung: Du übernimmst die Betreuung und strategische Weiterentwicklung des E-Commerce-Geschäfts eines großen Mandanten und bist Eskalationsinstanz bei operativen und projektgetriebenen Fragestellungen seitens des Kunden und der Fachbereiche.
- Führung & Teamentwicklung: Gemeinsam mit deinem Team schaffst du ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen ihr Potenzial entfalten können, förderst individuelle Entwicklung und setzt klare Prioritäten für nachhaltige Erfolge.
- Innovation & Business Development: Eigenständig überwachst und optimierst du die Business Performance und Prozessketten mittels datenbasierter Analysen und relevanter Kennzahlen. Gemeinsam mit dem Kunden definierst und steuerst du Projekte zur Weiterentwicklung der E-Commerce-Prozesse und zur Erschließung von Wachstumspotenzialen.
- Performance Management: Die Steuerung von Budget-, Forecast- sowie Ergebnisprozessen gehört ebenso zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich wie die Ableitung konkreter Maßnahmen zur kontinuierlichen Optimierung.
- Kundenbeziehungen & Service Excellence: Als zentrale:r Ansprechpartner:in baust du vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, stellst die Einhaltung vereinbarter Service Levels sicher und sorgst für eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit.

Qualifikationen

- Ausbildung & Studium: Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Betriebswirtschaft, Logistik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Account Management, Business Development oder Customer Management innerhalb des E-Commerce-, Logistik- oder Kontraktlogistikumfelds zeichnet dich aus.
- Führungskompetenz: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Mitarbeitenden sowie in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Teams mit.
- IT-Kenntnisse: Der sichere Umgang mit SAP sowie sehr gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft PowerPoint sind zwingend erforderlich. Gute Kenntnisse in den gängigen Microsoft-Office-Anwendungen, insbesondere Excel, runden dein Profil ab.
- Prozess- & Datenverständnis: Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für End-to-End-Prozesse sowie für die Zusammenhänge zwischen operativen und IT-gestützten Abläufen zeichnet dich aus. Erfahrung im Umgang mit KPIs, datenbasierten Prozessketten, Datenbanken und Schnittstellen ist von Vorteil.
- Sprachen & Persönlichkeit: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. Darüber hinaus überzeugst du durch unternehmerisches Denken, analytische Stärke, Eigeninitiative, Kommunikationsgeschick und die Fähigkeit, Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele zu begeistern.

Zusätzliche Informationen

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel mit modernen Arbeitszeitmodellen und der Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten.
- Verantwortung mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Von Beginn an übernimmst du einen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich und kannst strategische Entscheidungen aktiv mitgestalten.
- Corporate Benefits: Profitiere von attraktiven Rabatten auf zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Fashion, Technik, Reisen und vielem mehr.
- Persönliche & fachliche Weiterentwicklung: Nutze vielfältige Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, um deine Karriere gezielt voranzutreiben.
- ArvatoCare – Betriebliche Krankenkasse: Da uns deine Gesundheit am Herzen liegt, bieten wir dir eine kostenfreie betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit einem jährlichen Gesundheitsbudget und attraktiven Zusatzleistungen.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die zur Vielfalt unseres Unternehmens beitragen. Vielfalt beziehen wir insbesondere auf die Dimensionen kulturelle oder soziale Herkunft, Religion, Alter, Behinderung, Geschlecht und sexuelle Identität.

Wir möchten den Bewerbungsprozess so einfach wie möglich für dich halten: Fokussiere dich auf einen aussagekräftigen Lebenslauf, ein aufwendiges Anschreiben benötigen wir nicht. Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir deine Bewerbung ausschließlich über unser Online-Bewerbungsportal annehmen können.

title: Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting (Business-Analyst/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting

Stellenbeschreibung:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Senior Specialist, Non-Financial Reporting to join the Finance team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

This teammate will play a critical role in driving DH’s global CSRD-compliant (Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive) non-financial report disclosure across our network of brands and their operating countries. This role will work closely with the broader team responsible for non-financial reporting, key central stakeholders like Finance, People & Culture, Legal, Product, and other functions, but also global stakeholders from network brands. This teammate will help to implement transformative partnerships, roadmaps, and project plans to collate required quantitative and qualitative information, produce, and externally assure DH’s annual non-financial report. Over the next period this role will help evolve non-financial reporting, risk management, and internal controls up to par with financial reporting.

- Play a leading role in the production of the annual global non-financial report for the group.
- Develop communication materials to effectively engage stakeholders, providing clear context and guidance on CSRD reporting requirements
- Lead or support annual reporting on EU Taxonomy, non-financial risk assessment, and the coordination of new non-financial reporting regulations.
- Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape and ensure disclosures remain aligned with leading global frameworks, such as GRI, SASB, TCFD, and ISSB.
- Collaborate with Investor Relations on materials for, and queries from, investors; lead on annual ESG disclosures (e.g., potentially CDP).
- Support and lead on aspects of external assurance for the non-financial report; continue optimising and evolving related processes from year to year incl. automation.
- Lead on projects and initiatives that contribute to the reporting readiness of the Group in relation to the new regulations (CSRD).

Qualifications

- Strong interest and experience in leading non-financial reporting and external assurance work/working directly with auditors – in the corporate setting, or at a consultancy/as an auditor.
- Ability to learn quickly, with excellent qualitative analytical skills – to understand ESRS standards on various non-financial topics and help internal partner teams collate and refine disclosure content.
- Ability to process multiple workstreams at the same time, proven project management skills and attention to detail
- Degree in a field that builds related skills, knowledge and experience in a related role, with strong stakeholder management skills.
- Fluency in English and strong verbal, written, and presentation skills; proven organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to process multiple tasks and workstreams in parallel in a dynamic environment.
- A strong, flexible, and team/growth-oriented mindset.

Nice to have:

- Knowledge of German and European non-financial reporting regulations (CSRD, EU Taxonomy, NFRD), GRI, SASB, and especially TCFD
- Basic greenhouse gas (GHG) accounting principles.
- Fluency in German is a plus to ensure alignment between DH’s German and English non-financial report disclosures.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

Ready to join our team? (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/howwehire) If you’re excited to grow, collaborate and be part of the world’s leading delivery platform, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

title: Mitarbeiter in Vollzeit, Teilzeit im Bereich Tiefbau/Hochbau/Betonbau (Tiefbaufacharbeiter/in (ohne Angabe des Schwerpunkts))
description:
Die Firma Schwabenbau Oppenländer ist ein regionales, inhabergeführtes und wachsendes Unternehmen mit Sitz in 73663 Berglen. Unsere Tätigkeitsbereiche umfassen insbesondere den Tiefbau, Erd- und Baggerarbeiten, Garten- und Landschaftsbau sowie Hochbau- und Maurerarbeiten. Wir führen abwechslungsreiche Projekte für private, gewerbliche und öffentliche Auftraggeber aus und legen großen Wert auf eine saubere und zuverlässige Ausführung unserer Arbeiten.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir **ab sofort einen motivierten und erfahrenen Mitarbeiter (m/w/d)** aus dem Bereich Tiefbau, Hochbau, Maurerhandwerk oder einem vergleichbaren Bauhandwerk. Berufserfahrung auf dem Bau ist für diese Stelle Voraussetzung. Gesucht wird eine zuverlässige und engagierte Person, die selbstständiges Arbeiten gewohnt ist, mitdenkt und Freude daran hat, gemeinsam im Team unterschiedliche Bauprojekte umzusetzen.

Das Aufgabengebiet ist vielseitig und umfasst je nach Baustelle unter anderem Tiefbau- und Erdarbeiten, Kanal- und Entwässerungsarbeiten, Fundament- und Betonarbeiten, Maurerarbeiten, Pflaster- und Außenanlagenarbeiten sowie allgemeine Tätigkeiten im Hoch- und Tiefbau. Durch unser breites Leistungsspektrum bieten wir einen abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsalltag mit unterschiedlichen Projekten und Herausforderungen.

Wir bieten einen sicheren und abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsplatz in einem gesunden, kollegialen Team, ein sehr gutes Betriebsklima, moderne Maschinen und Arbeitsgeräte sowie kurze Entscheidungswege. Ein respektvoller und unkomplizierter Umgang miteinander ist uns besonders wichtig. Bei uns soll nicht nur die Leistung stimmen, sondern auch der Spaß an der gemeinsamen Arbeit erhalten bleiben.

Vorausgesetzt werden Berufserfahrung im Bauhandwerk, handwerkliches Geschick, Zuverlässigkeit, Motivation und Teamfähigkeit. Der Führerschein der Klasse B ist erforderlich. Weitere Führerscheinklassen wie BE, C oder CE sind von Vorteil, jedoch keine Voraussetzung.

Wir suchen einen Mitarbeiter, der langfristig Teil unseres Teams werden möchte, Verantwortung übernimmt und gemeinsam mit uns weiter wachsen will. Ein kurzfristiger Einstieg ist möglich.

title: Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d) (Fachinformatiker/in - Systemintegration)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Fachinformatiker/in für Digitale Vernetzung; Kaufmann/-frau für IT-System-Management; IT-Projektleiter

Stellenbeschreibung:
Verbinde Business & IT: Führe unsere Infrastruktur agil in die Cloud!

Du denkst in Lösungen statt in Problemen und schlägst spielend leicht die Brücke zwischen moderner IT-Technologie und wirtschaftlicher Effizienz? Perfekt! Für unser Partnerunternehmen – einen führenden Akteur in Weiden in der Oberpfalz – suchen wir eine dynamische, agile Führungspersönlichkeit mit starkem Wirtschaftsinformatik-Mindset.

In dieser Schlüsselposition verbindest du technisches Know-how in der Server- und Endgeräte-Landschaft mit kaufmännischer Verantwortung. Du führst ein motiviertes 10-köpfiges IT-Team mit Vertrauen, treibst die Cloud-Transformation voran und optimierst internationale Collaboration-Prozesse. Randstad begleitet dich dabei persönlich im Rahmen der direkten Personalvermittlung.

Ihre Aufgaben

- **Agile Teamführung:** Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Leitung deines 10-köpfigen IT-Infrastruktur-Teams (Infrastructure / Operations), förderst Eigenverantwortung und lebst eine transparente Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe vor.
- Infrastruktur & Cloud-Transformation: Du verantwortest die Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der hybriden Server- und Endgeräte-Infrastruktur (On-Premise & Cloud) und begleitest den schrittweisen Wandel hin zu modernen Cloud-Services.
- **Internationales Collaboration Management:** Du betreust und optimierst moderne Collaboration-Tools (insb. Google Workspace) in enger Abstimmung mit internationalen Unternehmensbereichsgruppen.
- **Schnittstelle & Budgetverantwortung:** Du arbeitest eng mit dem Abteilungsleiter Infrastructure zusammen, wirkst aktiv an der Budget- und Kostenplanung mit und behältst die wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen im Blick.
- **Servicemanagement & Provider-Steuerung:** Du koordinierst externe Dienstleister und stellst reibungslose, schanke ITIL-Betriebsprozesse sicher.

Unsere Anforderungen

- **Qualifikation:** Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit IT-Schwerpunkt oder eine vergleichbare IT-Ausbildung (z. B. als Fachinformatiker) mit starker kaufmännischer Orientierung.
- **Erfahrung & Führungswille:** Einschlägige Praxis im IT-Infrastruktur-Umfeld (Server, Endgeräte, Netzwerke). Erste Führungserfahrung ist ideal – alternativ bringen dich deine Ambitionen und dein Führungsdrive in den nächsten Karriereschritt.
- Tech & Cloud-Affinität: Solides Grundwissen zu Cloud-Architekturen sowie idealerweise Praxiserfahrung mit Google Workspace.
- **Kaufmännisches Denken:** Ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Budgetierung, Kostenstrukturen und das wirtschaftliche Steuern von IT-Ressourcen.
- **Agiles Mindset:** Hohe Organisationsstärke, Entscheidungsfreude sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verbindlich zu vermitteln.
- **Sprachkenntnisse:** Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse für die internationale Zusammenarbeit.

Wir bieten Ihnen

- **Modernes Arbeitsumfeld & Freiraum:** Echter Gestaltungsspielraum bei einem führenden Unternehmen, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum für deine eigenen agilen Impulse.
- **Zukunftssicherheit:** Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit langfristiger Perspektive im Rahmen der direkten Personalvermittlung.

title: HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d) (Compliance-Manager/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als HR Compliance Specialist (w/m/d).

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann auch an folgenden Standorten lokalisiert sein:

- Amadora, Portugal- Bratislava, Slowakei- Budapest, Ungarn- Madrid, Spanien- Prag, Tschechische Republik- Warschau, Polen

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Sie sind zuständig für die Konzeption, Implementierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des HR-internen Kontrollsystems.- Sie koordinieren und übernehmen Aktivitäten im Bereich Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR) für HR-relevante Prozesse.- Sie entwickeln, dokumentieren und optimieren Kontrolldesigns zur Sicherstellung regulatorischer und interner Compliance-Anforderungen.- Sie überwachen die Wirksamkeit etablierter Kontrollen, analysieren Kontrollschwächen und treiben geeignete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen nach.- Sie wirken bei der Durchführung von Control-Monitoring-Aktivitäten mit und bereiten Nachweise für interne und externe Audits auf.- Sie sind zuständig für Überwachung von Cybersecurity Controls innerhalb der HR-Funktion und arbeiten eng mit Cybersecurity-, IT- und Business-Stakeholdern zusammen.- Sie beraten Prozessverantwortliche hinsichtlich Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Anforderungen und fördern die Standardisierung von Prozessen und Kontrollen.- Sie erstellen Management-Reports, Dashboards und Entscheidungsvorlagen für Führungskräfte und relevante Governance-Gremien.

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Master-Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Wirtschaftsrecht, Compliance, Risikomanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Compliance, Internal Controls, Audit, Risk Management oder Governance.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung mit internen Kontrollsystemen (ICS), ICFR-/SOX-nahen Anforderungen oder Audit-Prozessen.- Sie haben gute Kenntnisse von HR-Prozessen sowie deren Risiko- und Kontrollanforderungen sind von Vorteil.- Sie haben fundierte Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.- Sie haben keinen Studienabschluss? Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Berufsausbildung in Verbindung mit einer qualifizierten Weiterbildung und darauf bezogene umfangreiche fachspezifische Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über fließende Englischkenntnisse, gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil- Sie verfügen über ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise.- Sie können komplexe Compliance- und Kontrollanforderungen verständlich vermitteln.- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.- Sie überzeugen durch Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Stakeholder ohne direkte Weisungskompetenz zu beeinflussen.- Sie bringen eine hohe Integrität sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risiko- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein mit.- Sie treiben Veränderungen aktiv voran und fördern eine nachhaltige Compliance- und Kontrollkultur.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist Klaus Kouril.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages

the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and

Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to

implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.
. Accurately logging all Dealer contacts and following up on cases using Opel/Vauxhall database systems.
. Attending team and other meetings for review of issues, assignments, regular discussion.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: GD Machine Technician
description:
Nicopods ehf. is an Icelandic manufacturer of nicotine pouches, the company is growing fast and expanding internationally. We're looking for a skilled GD Machine Technician to join our production team.

About the role:
You'll be responsible for the setup, operation, and maintenance of our G.D (Coesia Group, Bologna) pouch-filling line, ensuring efficient, high-quality production with minimal downtime. This is a hands-on technical role central to our manufacturing operation.

Responsibilities:
•    Operate and monitor the G.D pouching line during production runs
•    Perform changeovers, calibration, and routine maintenance
•    Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and PLC/HMI faults, minimizing downtime
•    Conduct preventive maintenance according to schedule
•    Ensure precise powder dosing and pouch sealing quality, meeting food-grade hygiene and quality standards
•    Document maintenance, faults, and production data
•    Collaborate with production and quality teams on continuous improvement

Requirements:
•    Proven experience operating and maintaining G.D (Coesia) machines, or comparable high-speed pouch-filling/sealing equipment (e.g. snus/modern oral pouch lines)
•    Strong mechanical and/or electrical troubleshooting skills
•    Experience in a manufacturing/production environment, ideally food, pharma, or consumer goods
•    Ability to read technical manuals and machine documentation
•    Willingness to work shifts as required by production schedule
•    Working proficiency in English (spoken and written)
-       Valid driving license B

What we offer:
•    Competitive salary in line with Icelandic industry standards according to collective agreements with Efling union.
•    Role in a fast-growing, internationally ambitious company
•    Direct impact on production quality and output

Employer provides housing or assistance with finding housing in Iceland.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: and put "260724-01" in the field for employer.
Further information about the position provided by contacting email: olafur@icepouch.is.

title: Associate Development Director and Advisor
description:
About Contradictum Advisory ehf.

Contradictum Advisory ehf. is a startup dedicated to advising international intellectual property holders in the management and licensing their assets with the objective to steer part of that revenue stream into underfunded projects in Iceland.  Particular emphasis is placed on projects that both serve an immediate domestic need in Iceland and that would meet eligibility requirements under the European Union Green Bond Standard and qualify for the Nordic Swan ecolabel.
Associate Development Director and Advisor.

This is a client-facing position comprised of two primary areas of competence.  The first is in providing advisory and consulting services to intellectual property owners in the North American Market with respect to the use, management, and monetization of their IP portfolios.  The second is in facilitating the investment of IP derived revenue into Iceland-based projects.  Our customer base is comprised of individuals, privately held companies, and family offices who are open diversifying their holdings in EEA and EFTA jurisdictions.  Your role will be to effectively assist clients with maximizing IP derived revenue and presenting opportunities to invest that revenue into target projects in Iceland.  A solid understanding of intellectual property, contracts, procurement processes is essential.  

Main tasks and Responsibilities:
•    Provide strategic direction to clients with respect to intellectual property licensing within the relevant jurisdictional frameworks of each client portfolio.
•    Prepare and present pitch decks to potential investment partners.  
•    Develop investment-ready Iceland-based project proposals.
•    Manage and develop local network of interested counterpart stakeholder and professional service providers related to each project proposal.
•    Identify and liaise with potential new high-net-worth individual investors and small-midsized family office clients in North, Central, and South American markets.
•    Demonstrate extraordinary discretion in all interactions with clients, maintaining the utmost in confidentiality and candor.

Education and licensing:
•    Advanced university-level business or legal education required.  Doctorate of Jurisprudence or Masters of Business Administration with coursework in contracts or international transactions from a top university strongly preferred.
•    Educational coursework in environmental or natural resources usage from an Icelandic University preferred.
•    Admittance to practice before to any US Federal Court.
•    Membership in any North America-based First Nation or Tribal Bar Association strongly preferred.

Qualification Requirements:
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in intellectual property licensing.
•    Minimum 3 years of experience in real property development or prime-contractor representation is highly desirable
•    Minimum 3years of experience in international transactions is highly desirable.
•    Solid Understanding of USPTO and EUIPO standards and procedures.
•    Knowledge of securities and BizOp regulatory standards and requirements is highly desirable.
•    Ability to operate effectively in a multi-time-zone framework convenient to international client domestic work hours.

Language Skills:  Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation English skills are essential.  Additional languages are beneficial.
English [Required] Expert Level
Icelandic [Optional] Intermediate
Spanish [Optional] Intermediate

Compensation:
Compensation is chiefly commission based plus a minimum base salary of 500,000 ISK per month.

Work Hours:
Flexible working hours generally overlapping with the North American Market.  Schedule is expected to vary based on specific client/project needs.
Contact:  For more information, please contact us at CAEHF@proton.me

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures and put "260805-02" in the field for employer.

title: Animal Care Manager
description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.

At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.


This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.


As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.

Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.


You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.

You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.

You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.

Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.

Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.

If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures/ and put "260714-06" in the field for employer.
Last application date is August 14, 2026

title: Join Iceland´s Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician
description:
Join Iceland's Acute Medicine Team - Consultant Physician

Help Shape the Future of Acute and Internal Medicine in Iceland

Are you an ambitious and enthusiastic Consultant Physician looking for an opportunity to make a lasting impact? Would you like to build a career with purpose in one of the world's most beautiful, and progressive countries?

Landspitali is undertaking one of the largest transformations of urgent and emergency care in its history. We are seeking Consultant Physicians in Internal Medicine and/or Acute Internal Medicine to join our multidisciplinary team as we design, develop and deliver the next generation of emergency services in Iceland working in a leading university hospital committed to innovation, education, and research.

Experience an outstanding work-life balance in Reykjavík, where a vibrant capital city meets spectacular nature. Physicians' standard daytime working hours are based on a 36-hour working week. Enjoy safe communities, short commutes, world-class outdoor adventures, excellent schools and healthcare, and easy access to Europe and North America.

Landspitali is developing a new integrated model of urgent and emergency care focused on:
•    Improving patient flow
•    Delivering safer, more efficient and person-centered care
•    Developing innovative pathways for acutely ill patients

Successful applicants will play a key role in developing several new clinical services, including:
•    Acute Medical Unit (AMU)
•    Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC)
•    Hospital at Home

Why join Landspitali we offer:
•    A rewarding consultant-level position
•    Opportunities to take on leadership roles in developing new services
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams
•    An academic environment where clinical excellence, research, teaching and innovation go hand in hand
•    The opportunity to contribute to a transformation that will benefit thousands of patients every year
•    Excellent opportunities to achieve a healthy work life balance.
•    A supportive working environment that values staff wellbeing and professional development.
•    Structured Icelandic language training, including formal courses and digital learning resources.

The position is full-time (100%) or as otherwise agreed and is available immediately or by mutual agreement.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:
•    Clinical work across inpatient wards, the Acute Medical Assessment Unit (AMAU), and Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC) services
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine inpatient admitting team
•    Participation in the General Internal Medicine on-call rota
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students and resident doctors in training
•    Opportunities to participate in research activities
•    Participation in quality improvement and patient safety initiative
•    Contributing to the ongoing development of Acute Medicine and General Internal Medicine services

QUALIFICATIONS:
•    Specialist registration (or equivalent) in General Internal Medicine, Acute Internal Medicine, or Family Medicine/General Practice with an emphasis on Acute Care
•    Broad clinical experience in Acute and/or General Internal Medicine
•    Excellent communication and the ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary team
•    A commitment to quality improvement, innovation and the development of high-value healthcare services.

Salary according to the current collective agreement concluded by the Minister of Finance and the Economy and the Medical Association of Iceland. Monday – Friday (with flexibility to attend events) About the Role We are looking for an experienced and proactive Staffing Manager to lead the attraction, recruitment, onboarding and deployment of high-volume workforces for a major event. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing strategic workforce planning with hands-on recruitment delivery. You will be responsible for ensuring staffing requirements are met, compliance standards are maintained and workforce plans are delivered efficiently to support business growth and operational excellence. Working closely with operational leaders, HR teams and external partners, you will play a key role in building engaged, high-performing teams that deliver exceptional service. What You Will Be Doing Recruitment & Workforce Planning Lead end-to-end recruitment campaigns across operational, management and specialist roles. Build and maintain talent pipelines to meet the business needs. Develop attraction strategies using job boards, social media, networking and community partnerships. Forecast staffing requirements and support workforce planning activities. Manage agency relationships and recruitment suppliers. Onboarding & Compliance Ensure all recruitment activity complies with employment legislation and company policy. Oversee Right to Work documentation, references and pre-employment screening. Maintain accurate employee records and workforce data. Support audit and compliance requirements across the recruitment lifecycle. Training & Employee Experience Coordinate onboarding and induction programmes. Support completion of mandatory training requirements. Work with stakeholders to identify workforce development needs. Champion a positive candidate and employee experience. Operational Support Collaborate with business leaders to deliver workforce plans effectively. title: CFD Software Developer (Softwareentwickler/in)
description:
CFD Software Engineer (f/m/d)
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the
world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation—helping innovative
global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a
large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together
while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages
creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our
business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.
Position Overview
Are you a passionate Software Engineer who enjoys working at
the intersection of numerical methods, high-performance computing, and
real-world engineering applications? We are searching for a talented CFD
Software Engineer to join our solver development team for Simcenter Ultrafluid (formerly Altair ultraFluidX, https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/products/simcenter/fluids-thermal-simulation/ultrafluid/) ), a small, dynamic, and agile team delivering world-class CFD software to
industries including automotive, heavy industry, and consumer electronics.
Simcenter Ultrafluid features a native GPU-based
implementation of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), allowing users to run
fully transient, high-fidelity aerodynamics and aeroacoustics simulations
overnight on a single compute server. The solver is designed to handle complex
geometries and demanding industrial use cases, delivering high-fidelity,
predictive simulations of real engineering processes, including turbulent
flows, thermal transport, and complex geometry handling.
If you are seeking a role where you can contribute directly
to solver development, algorithm implementation, and GPU acceleration, while
translating cutting-edge academic research in numerical methods into a
high-performance, easy-to-use software product, and collaborating closely with
the whole development team on the advancement of the code and its capabilities,
then we'd love to hear from you!
Responsibilities

- Contribute
to the code development of Simcenter Ultrafluid as part of the agile
development team
- Specify,
implement, test, and document new high-quality features of the solver in
close collaboration with the other team members
- Contribute
to performance benchmarking and code optimization in a massively parallel
GPU environment, while collaborating with other development teams across
HPC, pre/post-processing, and meshing to integrate Simcenter Ultrafluid
into the broader Simcenter ecosystem
- Collaborate
with product management, application specialists, and QA engineers to
ensure the solver meets real-world industrial needs
- Participate
in daily stand-ups as well as regular review, retrospective, and planning
meetings

Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

- M.Sc.
or Ph.D. degree in mechanical engineering, computational mechanics,
computer science, or a comparable physics-based discipline
- At
least two years of hands-on experience in CFD solver development in a
commercial or academic environment
- High
proficiency in C++ and parallel programming
- Excellent
English communication skills
- Passion
for numerical simulation and a drive to find creative solutions for
challenging industrial use cases with a focus on customer value
- Willingness
to work in a close-knit, agile development team

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience
with scripting or scientific programming languages such as Python or Julia
- Solid
understanding of the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and its application in
CFD
- Solid
understanding of GPU architectures and experience with the CUDA toolkit

Why us?
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by
default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than
200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through
real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale
and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and
inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring you curiosity
and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
Siemens Software. Transform the Everyday

Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. Hai queste caratteristiche? Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria o discipline STEM affini. Competenza nell'uso di strumenti RAMS (es. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. description: ADDETTO/A ALL'ASSEMBLAGGIO MECCANICO Per realtà metalmeccanica ricerchiamo una figura da inserire come addetto assemblaggio con scopo inserimento. SCOPO DEL RUOLO Assemblare correttamente le parti meccaniche nel rispetto delle indicazioni ricevute e delle procedure aziendali. Supportare il funzionamento e la manutenzione dei macchinari. RESPONSABILITA' Puntualità e correttezza nell'esecuzione delle procedure di assemblaggio Pulizia e manutenzione dei macchinari Messa in sicurezza delle macchine Ottemperamento degli standard di qualità aziendali Rispetto delle tempistiche previste PRINCIPALI MANSIONI Si occupa dell'assemblaggio meccanico dei componenti di una ginocchiera: posiziona manualmente i velcri adesivi, assembla i passanti, le cuffie e la parte superiore ed inferiore delle ginocchiera tramite una piastrina che viene rivettata, piega le parti in alluminio e confeziona manualmente la ginocchiera. Sulla base delle necessità produttive, utilizza le macchine rivettatrici, le presse, le calandre, le imboccolatrici, prestando attenzione alla corretta messa in sicurezza della macchina e al corretto settaggio prima dell'uso. Verifica la sicurezza e la funzionalità dei macchinari che utilizza quotidianamente. Segue con attenzione le istruzioni per il corretto assemblaggio di ogni parte di ciascuna lavorazione. Effettua la pulizia e la manutenzione delle macchine con l'aria compressa e appositi panni. Effettua il rabbocco dell'olio nei macchinari utilizzati. Gestisce l'inventario utilizzando il conto manuale e la bilancia di precisione contapezzi con cui si contano i componenti presenti in reparto. Si interfaccia con area UT per lo sviluppo di campioni e/o per l'effettuazione di test funzionali. Interagisce con Area CQ per risolvere possibili NC emerse durante il ciclo produttivo. Utilizza quotidianamente attrezzature e strumenti da banco (quali a titolo di esempio trapani, pinze, cacciaviti) per ottimizzare l'assemblaggio meccanico. COMPETENZE TECNICHE Preferibili conoscenze delle procedure di assemblaggio dei componenti meccanici Preferibile conoscenza dei macchinari utilizzati in azienda (presse, calandre, imboccolatrici) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di attrezzature manuali (cacciaviti, pinze) Preferibile conoscenza nell'utilizzo di strumenti elettrici (avvitatori, trapani) Orario di lavoro: full-time dal lunedì al venerdì 08.00-12.00/13.00-17.00 Offerta Contrattuale: - Inserimento con contratto di somministrazione a tempo determinato - CCNL applicato: metalmeccanici PMI - Livello di inquadramento: 3° livello - Retribuzione prevista: circa 2000 lordi mensili Luogo di lavoro: Dossobuono di Villafranca (Vr) Via A. Windchill Quality Solutions/ReliaSoft), sistemi di requisiti/PLM/ERP (es. DOORS/DOORS Next, Teamcenter, SAP) e analisi dati (Excel/Power BI; SQL). Conoscenza degli standard ASD S-Series (S2000M, S3000L, S5000F), MIL-STD-1388 (LSA/LSAR) e dei principali framework di safety engineering (ARP4754A/ARP4761, MIL-STD-882E). Capacità di redigere documentazione tecnica in inglese (report di supportabilità, FMECA/FHA/FTA, piani di manutenzione, estratti LSDB) e di gestire baseline/variazioni di configurazione. title: Researcher bridging immunology, genomics and proteomics (academic-industry collaboration)
description:
About the position

Applicants are invited to apply for a two-year Researcher position (SKO 1109) in immuno-proteomics (hands-on biology). The position is based at the Department of Immunology, Division of Laboratory Medicine, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo.

The position is available from July 2026 with a flexible start date between July and September 2026. It is a full-time role physically based at GSK Vaccines S.r.l. in Siena, Italy, within the MS Structural Biology, Ab Discovery and Immunology unit. Scientific advising and guidance will be provided by Dr. Greiff (Lab for Computational and Systems Immunology, greifflab.org).

The researcher will develop and establish an Ig-seq platform bridging immunoglobulin profiling, B-cell receptor (BCR) repertoire sequencing and serology.


More about the position

The proposed project aims to investigate the polyclonal humoral immune response to a model viral antigen in human samples from pre-exposed individuals. This research integrates advanced techniques, including antigen-specific B-cell sorting, B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing, and LC-MS/MS-based identification of circulating antigen-specific antibodies. The goal is to link B-cell clonotypes to serum immunoglobulins and resolve functional proteoforms through an immunoproteogenomics approach. The project will involve developing de novo sequencing workflows for antigen-specific antibodies, building proteogenomic pipelines to assemble VH/VL sequences and identify clonotypes. Data will be integrated matching BCR repertoires of PBMCs, tonsil tissue, and matched sera from GSK human biological samples. Computational modeling and machine learning will be essential for antibody identification, epitope prioritization, and cross-cohort comparisons.

The project focuses on deconvoluting pathogen-specific humoral responses to a seasonal viral pathogen by combining paired BCR repertoire sequencing with antigen-resolved LC-MS/MS proteomics. The candidate's responsibilities will encompass the development and analysis of mass spectrometry methods for antibody isolation and characterization, as well as designing and validating multiparameter flow cytometry panels for antigen-specific B-cell and plasma cell identification and sorting. The role demands rigorous data stewardship, collaboration with immunology, proteomics, and bioinformatics teams, primarily at GSK Siena, and contributing to the dissemination of research findings.


Key Duties 
  • BCR library preparation and sequencing workflows,
  • Implementing bioinformatics pipelines for clonotyping, lineage tracing, and proteogenomic integration
  • Performing comparative analyses with published datasets.

 Qualifications

Qualification requirements

  • Appointment to the position of researcher in position code 1109 requires a doctoral degree in Proteomics
  • Hands-on experience with LC-MS/MS method development for proteins/antibodies, including sample prep, instrument setup, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Python/R and scientific computing, and reproducible research practices (Git, containers/workflows).
  • Ability to build and run bioinformatic pipelines (de novo peptide sequencing, spectral annotation, FDR control).
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.
     

Desired qualifications

  • Expertise in immune receptor immunology (BCR/TCR) and repertoire analytics (clonotyping, lineage tracing, SHM, germline inference).
  • Experience with BCR repertoire analysis (Bulk and/or single cell)
  • Experience with advanced Flow Cytometry and Cell Sorting.
  • Structural biology/protein informatics relevant to antibody-antigen interactions and developability assessment.
  • Experience with complementary fragmentation methods (HCD/ETD/EThcD), intact/middle-down workflows, and disulfide/glycoform mapping.
  • High-performance/parallel computing; familiarity with ML frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow) and benchmarking.
  • Prior experience integrating proteomics and repertoire sequencing (immunoproteogenomics)
     

Personal skills
  • Collaborative, adaptable, and effective in an interdisciplinary, ambitious environment.
  • Independent, solution-oriented, and organised; strong scientific rigor and documentation practices
     

We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

 

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


We offer
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A scientifically rich, interdisciplinary and international environment at GSK Siena with access to state-of-the-art proteomics and flow cytometry facilities.
  • Advising and mentorship by Prof. Victor Greiff; opportunities for collaboration across immunology, proteomics, and computational teams.
  • Professional development, training, and conference participation.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 640 000 to 760 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

 

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Application letter.
  • CV.
  • A complete list of publications.
  • Project/research plan aligned with the position scope
  • Transcripts and certificates.
  • Contact information for 2-3 references.

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to  Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO.

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Institute of Clinical Medicine (Klinmed) is one of three institutes under the Faculty. Klinmed is responsible for the Faculty's educational and research activities at Oslo University Hospital and Akershus University Hospital. With about 900 employees spread over approximately 425 man-labour years, Klinmed is the university's largest institute. Our activities follow the clinical activity at the hospitals and are spread across a number of geographical areas.

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

6.    Pedagoginių ir psichologinių žinių kursų išklausymo dokumento kopiją (jei asmuo neturi pedagogo kvalifikacijos).

Pretendentai dokumentus pristato asmeniškai (mokyklos adresu), siunčia registruotu laišku arba elektroniniu paštu: mokykla@panmm.lt iki 2026 m. rugpjūčio 24 d. 14.00 val.
